Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.
2610.12124.update_target: Hierarchical intent memory, experience summaries, and skills; no parameter updates
2610.12124.mechanism_zh: 按嵌套意图整理当前工作，递归压缩旧历史但保留原始交互；被重新调用的经验与新经验共同巩固和更新。
2610.12124.result_zh: 摘要给出统一工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累与技能学习的机制，没有提供量化提升数值。
2610.12124.boundary_zh: 作为经验进化机制收录；没有摘要定量结果时，不自行补写性能优势或持续增益。
2610.12124.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体从单任务执行走向长期自主运行，使“如何把连续经验转化为可复用知识”成为关键挑战。为此，我们提出分层记忆与持续学习架构 Hippocam。它借鉴人类记忆的两个特点：认知过程有选择地维持与当前目标相关的信息，长期记忆则通过反复巩固逐渐形成。因此，Hippocam 将智能体持续工作组织为嵌套意图。活动上下文始终以当前意图为中心，已经完成的意图被整合为后续工作需要的任务相关结果和状态，而不继续携带完整工作细节。同时，递归前缀巩固机制反复整合更早历史，使长期未使用的经验逐渐抽象化。原始交互仍被保留，智能体可沿层级逐步恢复更细信息，并在信息充足时停止。关键是，旧经验一旦被回忆并重新融入当前工作，就会与新经验一起继续被巩固，从而得到强化、补充和更新。通过这种使用与弃用的记忆动态，Hippocam 在统一、持续演化的经验过程中连接工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累和技能学习，使智能体无需参数更新即可通过自身经验学习并演化能力。
2610.12124.title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
2610.12124.authors: Xiangyi Zeng, Baihang Liu, Xutong Wang, Ze Jin, Yunpeng Li, Qixu Liu
2610.12124.affiliation: Institute of Information Engineering, CAS / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences ([Source](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.12124))
2610.12124.mechanism_en: Organize current work by nested intent and recursively compress old history while retaining original interactions. Recalled and new experiences are consolidated and updated together.
2610.12124.result_en: The abstract describes a mechanism unifying working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning, without quantitative improvement figures.
2610.12124.boundary_en: Included as an experience-evolution mechanism. Do not invent performance advantages or sustained gains absent from the abstract.

2610.12235.abstract_en: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.
2610.12235.update_target: Research-outcome prediction and candidate selection supported by experimental experience
2610.12235.mechanism_zh: RWM 预测候选研究干预的结果，复用同环境及跨环境实验知识，在固定选择预算下指导多轮 Autoresearch。
2610.12235.result_zh: 超过 2,600 条实验记录、九类环境、171,000 H100 GPU 小时；有经验时固定预算最佳增益提高 15.8%/11.6%。
2610.12235.boundary_zh: 171,000 GPU 小时是所依赖实验记录规模，不能写成这套方法本身的低成本；预算内选择增益不等于预测器权重自主改进。
2610.12235.abstract_zh: AI 研究智能体自动化提出、实现和评估实验的循环，为递归自我改进打开路径。但提出实验的能力超过了在真实环境执行的能力，因此结果预测是有限实验预算下持续自改进的关键。我们研究作为研究世界模型（RWM）的语言模型，它们预测跨研究环境的候选干预结果。评估使用九个涵盖预训练、后训练和推理的研究环境中的 2,600 多条实验记录，代表超过 171,000 H100 GPU 小时的实验。由真实实验经验获得的研究知识，改善 RWM 对同环境未见干预的预测（Spearman 增加 0.27），也能跨环境复用。例如，仅使用 OLMo3、Marin 和 Nanochat 的预训练经验，RWM 就能使 Qwen3 环境中的选择遗憾相对零经验设置降低 78%。这些收益扩展到固定选择预算下的多轮 Autoresearch：具有环境内和跨环境研究知识的 RWM，使取得的最佳增益分别提高 15.8% 和 11.6%。跨 13 个作为 RWM 的语言模型的消融表明，增加研究知识对干预排序的改善，可能超过单独换用模型或提高推理投入。这些发现支持将语言模型作为 RWM，并鼓励为未来 RWM 训练积累实验数据。
2610.12235.title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
2610.12235.authors: Zijun Wang, Zewen Liu, Minhua Lin, Zhaotian Weng, Zhan Shi, Bing He, Yisi Sang, Dakuo Wang, Benoit Dumoulin, Wei Jin, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie, Hanqing Lu
2610.12235.affiliation: Amazon / UC Santa Cruz / Emory University / Pennsylvania State University / UC Santa Barbara ([Source](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.12235))
2610.12235.mechanism_en: RWM predicts candidate research interventions and reuses knowledge within and across environments to guide multiple Autoresearch rounds under a fixed selection budget.
2610.12235.result_en: The evidence base contains over 2,600 experiment records across nine environment types and 171,000 H100 GPU hours. With experience, best gains under a fixed budget improve by 15.8%/11.6%.
2610.12235.boundary_en: 171,000 GPU hours describes the supporting experiment corpus, not a low-cost property of the method. Selection gains do not establish autonomous predictor-weight improvement.

2610.11464.abstract_en: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.
2610.11464.image_note: Figure 1, PDF page 3; crop of the original PDF
2610.11464.update_target: Inspectable verifier expressions and the downstream skill-improvement loop
2610.11464.mechanism_zh: 从失败簇合成小型缺陷检测器，以十项锚定参考和无标签一致性选择验证器，选择目标不是 Agent 得分。
2610.11464.result_zh: MBPP+ 留出一致性较手写组合提高 0.21；去掉锚定保护会退化为总是通过的评分器，但下游技能仍可能变好。
2610.11464.boundary_zh: 下游分数上涨不能认证验证器正确性，是本篇最应保留的证据边界。
2610.11464.abstract_zh: 我们修改了智能体：它真的变好了吗？每个自改进闭环都会回答这一问题数百次，而每个答案都来自验证器。开放任务没有现成验证器，因此闭环往往依靠手写评价准则，或由类似模型的裸 LLM 评委评分，容易出现奖励利用和共同盲点。我们让验证器本身演化：它是由小型、主要确定性的缺陷检测器组成的可检查表达式，从聚类失败中综合，在产生时接受门控，并按与十项锚定参考集的一致性及无标签输出共识来选择，绝不按智能体得分选择。在 MBPP+ 上，它在每个随机种子下都比手写初始组合提高 0.21 的留出一致性，最终超过其包含的裸 LLM 评委。一项发现应改变共同进化验证器的验证方式：移除锚定保护会使验证器崩溃为毫无意义的“总是通过”评分器，但这个失效验证器仍能同样有效地训练技能。因此，下游任务得分不能认证自进化验证器。得分能够回答充分性问题，而在这一点上进化验证器可以替代外部信号：Double Ratchet 将验证器与具有生命周期管理的技能闭环结合，在代码生成、企业文本转 SQL 和无参考报告生成上，保留真实答案或评价准则给同一闭环带来的 88–110% 增益。当进化技能利用报告准则漏洞时，外部评委发现问题，加入一个检测器便完成修复；但这个评委本身也曾判断错误，直到获得任务契约。
2610.11464.title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
2610.11464.authors: Xing Zhang, Guanghui Wang, Yanwei Cui, Ziyuan Li, Wei Qiu, Bing Zhu, Peiyang He
2610.11464.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.11464.affiliation: AWS Forward Deployed Engineering / HSBC Technology Center, China ([Source](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.11464))
2610.11464.mechanism_en: Synthesize small defect detectors from failure clusters and select verifiers using ten anchored references and unlabeled agreement, rather than agent scores.
2610.11464.result_en: Held-out MBPP+ agreement improves by 0.21 over a handwritten composition. Removing anchor protection can produce an always-pass grader while downstream skills still improve.
2610.11464.boundary_en: Rising downstream scores cannot certify verifier correctness; this is the key evidence limit to retain.

2610.11655.abstract_en: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.
2610.11655.image_note: Figure 1, PDF page 2; crop of the original PDF
2610.11655.update_target: Harness-versus-weight intervention choices and trajectory internalization with LoRA
2610.11655.mechanism_zh: 按首个失败信号区分流程和内容错误，交叉比较初始/进化框架与基础/训练权重；加入答案打乱的安慰剂适配器。
2610.11655.result_zh: DeepPlanning 上 4B 的留出得分 0.16→0.30、9B 为 0.32→0.44；LoRA 在原框架下均再带来 +0.13。
2610.11655.boundary_zh: WebArena-Lite 上适配器没有额外收益，说明“把框架收益内化到权重”具有任务依赖性。
2610.11655.abstract_zh: 改进长任务 LLM 智能体，可以演化冻结模型外围的运行框架，也可以训练权重。我们先让自进化框架增强系统，再交叉组合初始和进化框架与基础和训练后权重，以了解哪些收益被模型保留，哪些仍依赖运行时。我们发现，可以从失败构成读出合适的干预方式：按首先触发的信号标记失败轨迹，区分流程错误（调用受阻、循环、步数耗尽）与内容错误（交付了质量不佳的计划）。框架进化修复前者，其诱导的行为可训练进权重，而内容错误是权重训练要解决的。在 DeepPlanning 上，自进化框架使 Qwen3.5-4B 留出得分从 0.16 提高到 0.30，Qwen3.5-9B 从 0.32 提高到 0.44；4B 留出交付率从 55% 到 90%，内容错误留给权重解决。基于进化框架轨迹训练的 LoRA 适配器将收益内化：在原框架下，两种规模均增加 0.13 的留出得分；4B 上与框架叠加使留出得分超过两倍，9B 上单用适配器就匹配完整进化方案，并将内容失败比例从四分之一降至二十分之一。用答案打乱轨迹训练的安慰剂适配器低于基础模型。闭环迁移至 WebArena-Lite，在 117 个未见任务上提高 0.09；该任务的收益来自模型所见信息，适配器没有额外帮助。结果给出两次“先诊断、后干预”的规则：先据失败构成在框架与权重之间选择，再据被接纳编辑改变了什么，决定内化哪些收益。得分是对照新锚点的四次轨迹均值，除特别标注外在同夜测量，覆盖六个系列的八个模型和两个基准。
2610.11655.title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
2610.11655.authors: Yuan Tian, Bing Hu, Hao Wang, Binghang Lu, Fang Wu
2610.11655.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

2610.10611.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems can improve by searching longer, receiving additional support, or modifying how they propose and verify outputs. A performance score does not distinguish these mechanisms. We compare these changes through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness. A stage specifies admissible transcripts, polynomial bounds, an alternating verification protocol, and a terminal checker. Its native reach uses default support; its closure frontier permits all support already admitted by the interface. Under a uniform pointwise probability gap and task-relative soundness, these are well-defined languages. We prove that independent majority amplification preserves both languages, whereas existential acceptance over random tapes can admit incorrect outputs. Exact verification is the zero-randomness case, with placement and completeness results. The randomized-verifier classes satisfy $\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteq\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteq\Sigma_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$; strict enlargement and depth separation require explicit complexity assumptions, while $\mathrm{BPP}=\mathrm{P}$ yields exact companions with the same frontiers. Representation analysis separates invariant acceptance from core-versus-support labels that can change under refactoring. For recursive self-improvement, uniformly bounded self-modification under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol remains within the same verification class. A separate conditional-error budget controls false selection across adaptively chosen candidates. A quota-enforced XOR-synthesis family separates unbounded ratios of search success from changes in the accepted languages; exact and probabilistic audits check the resulting evidence requirements. The framework ties self-improvement claims to obligations on correctness, admissible evidence, verification resources, and selection error.

2610.10611.update_target: Formal verification interfaces and resource limits for self-improvement claims
2610.10611.mechanism_zh: 区分默认支持下的可达范围与接口已允许支持的闭包前沿，给出有界随机验证和自适应候选选择错误预算。
2610.10611.result_zh: 论文证明共同可靠解释器与固定验证协议下，一致有界的自修改仍属于相同验证类；更强分离依赖明确复杂性假设。
2610.10611.boundary_zh: 这是带条件的理论结论；不能简化成“RSI 不可能”或“所有自修改都不增加能力”。
2610.10611.abstract_zh: 智能体 AI 可以通过更长搜索、获得额外支持，或修改提出和验证输出的方式来改进，但性能得分无法区分这些机制。我们用带隐藏末端随机性的有界验证比较这些变化。一个阶段规定允许的交互记录、多项式界、交替验证协议与末端检查器；其原生可达范围使用默认支持，闭包前沿则允许接口已准许的所有支持。在统一的逐点概率间隔和相对任务的可靠性下，它们构成良定义语言。我们证明，独立多数表决放大保留两种语言，而对随机带作存在量化的接纳可能容许错误输出。精确验证是零随机性的情形，并有归属与完备性结果。随机验证器类别满足 $Sigma_k^{mathrm{P}}subseteqSigma_k^{mathrm{RV}}subseteqSigma_{k+1}^{mathrm{P}}$；严格扩大和深度分离需要明确复杂性假设，而 $mathrm{BPP}=mathrm{P}$ 会产生具有相同前沿的精确对应物。表示分析将不变的接纳行为与可能随重构变化的核心/支持标签分离。对于递归自改进，在共同可靠解释器和固定验证协议下，一致有界的自修改仍位于相同验证类别。另一个条件错误预算控制对自适应选择候选的错误筛选。一个强制配额的 XOR 合成族，将搜索成功的无界比值与被接纳语言的变化区分开；精确和概率审计检验相应证据要求。该框架把自改进声明与正确性、可采纳证据、验证资源及选择错误的义务联系起来。
2610.10611.title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
2610.10611.mechanism_en: Distinguish reachability under default support from the closure frontier under interface-permitted support. Bound randomized verification and error budgets for adaptive candidate selection.
2610.10611.result_en: Under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol, the paper proves uniformly bounded self-modifications remain in the same verification class. Stronger separations rely on explicit complexity assumptions.
2610.10611.boundary_en: These are conditional theoretical conclusions, not a general claim that RSI is impossible or that all self-modification adds no capability.

2610.11803.abstract_en: Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mechanisms.

2610.11803.update_target: Joint learning dynamics of generators, learners, and symbolic archives
2610.11803.mechanism_zh: 用 KL 约束生成器更新并控制档案权重变化，限制单步目标漂移，分析档案选择与 SGD 的平均平稳性。
2610.11803.result_zh: 视觉鲁棒性、关系图及算法图推理实验呈现与理论机制一致的生成器稳定、损失下降和档案集中。
2610.11803.boundary_zh: 理论保证受噪声和漂移等假设约束；HTML 作者区有模板残留，本期作者与机构以 PDF 首页为准。
2610.11803.abstract_zh: 自改进学习系统会适应数据选择、优化方式及辅助符号组件，从而产生超出标准学习假设的非平稳目标。我们提出共同进化框架 PRAXIS，将生成器、学习器和符号档案建模为相互作用的动态过程。我们证明，KL 约束的生成器更新与受控的档案权重移动能够限制单步目标漂移；在次高斯噪声下，相对于任何持续具有累计效用优势的固定比较程序，档案更新会抑制较差程序；随机梯度下降具有平均平稳性保证，其退化由累计目标漂移控制。视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理和算法图推理实验显示生成器稳定、学习器损失下降及档案集中，这些现象与理论机制一致。
2610.11803.title: PRAXIS: Learning Dynamics of Self-Improving Models with Symbolic Archives
2610.11803.mechanism_en: Constrain generator updates with KL and control archive-weight changes to limit single-step objective drift; analyze archive selection and average stationarity of SGD.
2610.11803.result_en: Experiments on visual robustness, relational graphs, and algorithmic graph reasoning show generator stability, loss reduction, and archive concentration consistent with the theoretical mechanism.
2610.11803.boundary_en: Guarantees depend on assumptions about noise and drift. The HTML author block contains template remnants; this digest uses the PDF first page for authors and affiliations.

2610.12190.abstract_en: As claims about recursive self-improvement (RSI) and artificial general intelligence (AGI) proliferate, we ask a simple question: do frontier AI models have a sense of data, i.e., can they reliably select the right data for training? We introduce DataSense-Bench to study this capability through the fundamental problem of data selection and performance forecasting in machine learning. We ask AI agents to select and rank candidate training subsets that can be used to fine-tune a small LLM model. Agents are allowed to inspect the data, write and execute analysis code, and run model forward passes, but can not train the model or access the actual evaluation tasks. We then fine-tune the base model on each selected subset and evaluate its post-training performance under a standardized protocol. We instantiate the benchmark in terminal problem solving and tool use, selecting trajectories from OpenThoughts-Agent and EnvScaler and evaluating on TBLite and BFCL, respectively. We then evaluate the agents along two complementary dimensions: the post-training performance of the top-ranked subset, reflecting the ability to identify high-value training data, and ranking accuracy, reflecting the ability to predict the relative performance of the selected subsets. In our experiments, selection gains over random selection are limited; agents do not reliably rank their selected groups, and ranking ability does not hold consistently across tasks: Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but in only one of three terminal runs. Analysis of execution traces on both tasks shows that agents often use similar data signals while interpreting their training value differently.
2610.12190.update_target: Data selection and training-outcome prediction by research agents
2610.12190.mechanism_zh: Agent 可检查数据、写分析代码及运行前向传播，但不能训练或查看真实评估题；后续统一微调验证其排序。
2610.12190.result_zh: 两类任务中，相对随机选择收益有限；Astra 在三次工具使用运行中均找出最佳组，在三次终端运行中仅一次。
2610.12190.boundary_zh: 这是对 RSI 关键能力的评测及负面证据，不是已实现递归自改进的系统。
2610.12190.abstract_zh: 随着递归自我改进（RSI）和通用人工智能（AGI）的声明增多，我们提出一个简单问题：前沿 AI 模型是否具有数据判断力，即能否可靠地选择正确训练数据？我们提出 DataSense-Bench，通过机器学习中的基础问题——数据选择与性能预测——研究这一能力。我们让 AI 智能体选择并排序可用于微调小型 LLM 的候选训练子集。智能体可以检查数据、编写和执行分析代码、运行模型前向传播，但不能训练模型，也不能访问实际评估任务。随后，我们用每个所选子集微调基础模型，并按标准化协议评估后训练表现。基准实例化于终端问题求解和工具使用，分别从 OpenThoughts-Agent 和 EnvScaler 选择轨迹，并在 TBLite 和 BFCL 上评估。我们从两个互补维度评估智能体：排名最高子集的后训练表现，反映识别高价值数据的能力；以及排序准确性，反映预测所选子集相对表现的能力。实验中，相对随机选择的收益有限；智能体不能可靠排序自己选择的组，且排序能力不能跨任务稳定保持：Astra 在三次工具使用运行中均找到最佳组，但三次终端运行中仅一次。两项任务的执行轨迹分析显示，智能体通常采用相似数据信号，却对其训练价值作出不同解释。
2610.12190.title: DataSense-Bench: The First Step Toward an AI Scientist
2610.12190.authors: Yudi Zhang, Mingyu Cao, Lu Yin, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Shiwei Liu
2610.12190.affiliation: Eindhoven University of Technology / University of Surrey / ELLIS Institute Tübingen / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / Tübingen AI Center ([Source](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.12190))
2610.12190.mechanism_en: Agents inspect data, write analysis code, and run forward passes, but cannot train or see actual evaluation questions. Subsequent standardized fine-tuning validates their rankings.
2610.12190.result_en: Gains over random selection are limited across two task types. Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but only one of three terminal runs.
2610.12190.boundary_en: This provides evaluation and negative evidence for a capability needed by RSI; it is not an implemented recursive self-improvement system.

2610.10619.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly reshaping software engineering, accompanied by an explosion of new code benchmarks. Yet nearly all existing benchmarks still rely on the same decades-old criterion: a solution is correct if it passes a fixed set of unit tests. Such tests are often insufficient: they check only part of what the task requires, so agents can reward hack them or silently miss required behavior while still passing every test. As a result, higher benchmark scores may partly reflect better adaptation to the evaluator rather than better problem solving. Existing works focus on static test augmentation: they strengthen each task's tests once, before any trial is seen, and thus overlook how real trials actually fail. We introduce TestJack, a scalable framework for evaluating patches beyond fixed tests. For each trial, TestJack generates tests targeting prompt requirements the patch may violate, retains only tests passed by the ground-truth patch, and re-examines any trial failures. Each confirmed failure is thus supported by a replayable test. To reduce evaluation cost, we also introduce a lightweight variant which audits a random sample of trials in depth and reuses the resulting tests across all trials for the same task. Across 6 frontier model backends and 5 benchmarks such as DeepSWE and SWE Marathon, we find that about 34.4% of the model trials currently judged correct violate the task requirements, lowering the overall resolution rate from 50.6% to 33.2%. Our results reveal a fundamental limitation of current coding-agent evaluation: as LLMs become better at optimizing against fixed evaluators, those evaluators themselves must become more adaptive.
2610.10619.update_target: Evaluation tests evolving from candidate-patch failures
2610.10619.mechanism_zh: 针对补丁可能违反的需求生成测试，保留标准补丁能通过的测试并复核候选失败；轻量变体复用同题审计结果。
2610.10619.result_zh: 六个模型后端、五个基准中，原判正确的试验约 34.4% 违反需求，总解决率从 50.6% 调整为 33.2%。
2610.10619.boundary_zh: 该发现提醒审计自改进分数的真实性；不能仅因测试增加就断言模型本身变差。
2610.10619.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体正在迅速改变软件工程，新的代码基准也大量出现。但几乎所有基准仍依赖几十年来相同的标准：通过固定单元测试就算正确。此类测试往往不足，只检查部分任务要求，智能体可以利用奖励漏洞，或遗漏所需行为却仍通过所有测试。因此，更高基准得分可能部分反映对评估器的更好适应，而非更强的问题求解。已有工作关注静态测试增强，在看到任何试验前一次性加强每题测试，因此忽略真实试验如何失败。我们提出 TestJack，一个超越固定测试评估补丁的可扩展框架。对于每次试验，TestJack 针对补丁可能违反的提示要求生成测试，只保留标准答案补丁能通过的测试，并重新检查候选失败。每个确认的失败因此都有可重放测试支撑。为降低成本，我们还提出轻量变体：深入审计随机抽取的试验，并把产生的测试复用于同一任务的全部试验。在六个前沿模型后端及 DeepSWE、SWE Marathon 等五个基准上，我们发现目前被判为正确的模型试验约有 34.4% 违反任务要求，使总体解决率从 50.6% 降至 33.2%。这揭示了当前编程智能体评估的根本局限：当 LLM 更善于针对固定评估器优化时，评估器本身也必须更具适应性。
2610.10619.title: TestJack: Should you trust the results in coding benchmarks? Agentic Coding Benchmarks Auditing via Evaluator Evolution
2610.10619.authors: Shuangjie Yao, Hao Wang, Koushik Sen, Simin Chen, Baishakhi Ray, Dawn Song
2610.10619.affiliation: Columbia University / UC Berkeley / George Mason University ([Source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.10619#page=1))
2610.10619.mechanism_en: Generate tests for requirements that candidate patches may violate. Retain tests passed by the reference patch and recheck candidate failures; a lightweight variant reuses audits for the same problem.
2610.10619.result_en: Across six model backends and five benchmarks, about 34.4% of trials originally judged correct violate requirements; total resolution falls from 50.6% to 33.2% after auditing.
2610.10619.boundary_en: Audit the validity of self-improvement scores; adding tests alone does not imply the model itself has worsened.

2610.12289.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents have advanced test generation across diverse programming tasks. However, the common practice of evaluating tests against a single reference solution overlooks alternative valid implementations and can overstate test quality. We introduce TestPrism, comprising 300 test tasks from 17 sources and 3000 candidate implementations, evenly split between valid and invalid solutions. Its primary metric, Joint Success Function, requires the generated tests to fail on the initial program state, accept every valid candidate, and reject every invalid candidate. Across fourteen baseline coding agent configurations, Joint Success Function reaches only 28.00%, whereas single reference success reaches 59.67%. Our analysis reveals missed behaviors, unsupported assertions, and faulty test construction. To address these weaknesses, we introduce TestHelix, which combines heterogeneous synthesis of test and repair pairs with peer cross validation and recursive self improvement (RSI). Across two models, TestHelix improves Joint Success Function by 8.67 to 9.00 percentage points over the native harness comparators in the TestHelix evaluation
2610.12289.update_target: Test-generation and repair-pair loops, with multi-reference correctness evaluation
2610.12289.mechanism_zh: Joint Success Function 要求初始状态失败、所有合法实现通过、所有非法实现被拒；TestHelix 加入异构生成、交叉验证与 RSI。
2610.12289.result_zh: 300 题、17 个来源、3,000 个候选实现；十四种配置的联合成功率仅 28.00%，单参考成功率为 59.67%。
2610.12289.boundary_zh: 测试只接受一份参考实现可能误杀其他正确解；需在独立多实现集上验证自进化测试。
2610.12289.abstract_zh: LLM 编程智能体推动了多类编程任务的测试生成。但用单一参考解评估测试的常见做法，忽略其他合法实现，可能高估测试质量。我们提出 TestPrism，包含来自 17 个来源的 300 项测试任务和 3,000 个候选实现，其中合法与非法实现各占一半。主指标 Joint Success Function 要求生成测试在初始程序状态失败、接受每个合法候选，并拒绝每个非法候选。在十四种基线编程智能体配置中，该联合成功率仅为 28.00%，而单参考成功率达到 59.67%。分析揭示了遗漏行为、无依据断言和错误测试构造。为解决这些弱点，我们提出 TestHelix，将测试与修复对的异构合成、同行交叉验证和递归自我改进（RSI）结合。在两个模型上，TestHelix 在自身评估中，相比原生运行框架比较对象，将 Joint Success Function 提高 8.67–9.00 个百分点。
2610.12289.title: TestPrism: Rethinking Test Evaluation Beyond a Single Reference
2610.12289.authors: Han Li, Lingxiang Hu, Jiacheng Huang, Ziqian Jiang, Jingkai Luo, Wei Gao, Yunfan Tan, Zun Wang, Jiaheng Liu
2610.12289.affiliation: Nanjing University / Hong Kong Polytechnic University / Tencent ([Source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.12289#page=1))
2610.12289.mechanism_en: Joint Success Function requires failure on the initial state, acceptance of all valid implementations, and rejection of all invalid ones. TestHelix adds heterogeneous generation, cross-validation, and RSI.
2610.12289.result_en: Across 300 problems, 17 sources, and 3,000 candidate implementations, joint success for fourteen configurations is only 28.00%, versus 59.67% for single-reference success.
2610.12289.boundary_en: Tests that accept only one reference may reject other correct solutions; validate evolving tests on independent collections of implementations.

2610.12341.abstract_en: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
2610.12341.update_target: Executable game strategies and supporting software under frozen weights
2610.12341.mechanism_zh: 在固定对局和评估预算内，Agent 阅读规则、选对手、分析重放并修改程序；AAArena 对照历史人类竞赛程序。
2610.12341.result_zh: 12 个真实对抗游戏、1,920 份人类程序；Opus5.5 与 Claude Code 取得六枚金牌，另外六个排行榜未被任何配置登顶。
2610.12341.boundary_zh: 摘要含未展开的配置数量宏，不能猜数量；要将对手选择和反馈密度与策略修改本身区分。
2610.12341.abstract_zh: 对抗游戏推动了从启发式搜索到强化学习的进展，但从有限样本中学习和适应策略仍有挑战。AI 智能体提供了另一条路径：把游戏经验转化为可执行策略修订。在启发式学习（HL）基础上，我们形式化对抗启发式学习（AHL）：以 AI 智能体作为学习引擎，在模型权重固定时细化游戏策略及配套软件。我们提出 AAArena，包含 12 个真实对抗游戏和 1,920 份存档人类程序，评估协议仿照现实游戏竞赛。在固定对局和评估预算内，智能体理解规则、选择对手、分析重放并修订游戏程序，争取最高排名。我们评估了 al{completedmodels} 个模型与运行框架配置［原摘要的此宏未展开，数量未给出］：Opus5.5 配合 Claude Code 获得六枚金牌，但没有任何被评估配置在剩余六个人类排行榜登顶。规则说明越复杂的游戏，表现通常越弱。进一步实验表明，对手选择和稠密反馈支持策略改进；智能体既从自己的 on-policy 对局重放，也从其他玩家的 off-policy 重放中学习。这些结果展示 HL 在对抗游戏中的潜力，也揭示游戏理解、策略实现和长期策略开发方面的持续挑战。
2610.12341.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition

2610.12341.result_en: Across 12 competitive games and 1,920 human programs, Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns six gold medals; no configuration tops the other six leaderboards.
2610.12341.boundary_en: The abstract contains an unresolved macro for configuration count; do not guess it. Separate opponent selection and feedback density from strategy revision.

2610.10629.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. We argue that self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition) while model weights stay fixed, so that every adaptation is a diff with a cause and a test attached. We give a dual-loop engine built on that bound, with one admission gate that writes a hash-chained record before deployment, and we measure the gate in simulation, with a simulated agent and a seeded-search proposer rather than language models. Across three families of supervisory re-interpretation at three severities, 10 seeds each, the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history, and restored the false-positive rate to the oracle level without raising missed flags in every low- and mid-severity cell. With the gate replaced by the check an unbounded system applies (fewer errors visible in recent traces), the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs: false positives fell because the screen was loosened. Evaluated on pre-shift labels, the gate rejected every candidate, so a re-interpretation must be encoded as a rule that relabels history. Parametric and scope shifts were repaired locally, a structural one only by primitive replacement; at the highest structural severity the gate's fixed tolerance blocked the correct replacement in half the seeds. We map the mechanisms to the EU AI Act's provisions for high-risk credit scoring and note that the April 2026 US model-risk guidance excludes agentic AI from its scope.

2610.10629.mechanism_zh: 双循环改动指令、工具调用和原语组合；准入前写哈希链记录，并用重新标注的历史和留出历史评估。
2610.10629.result_zh: 模拟 Agent 与 seeded-search 提议器实验中，7,449 个候选仅接纳 144 个，均未增加留出历史错误；无门控对照接纳 309 个有害修改。
2610.10629.boundary_zh: 作者明确未用 LLM 做该实验，属于模拟证据；最高强度结构变化中固定容差也会阻挡正确修复。
2610.10629.abstract_zh: 自改进 LLM 智能体能够让信贷流程适应规则变化，但自行重写的智能体会破坏监督者审核的对象：具名修改、记录的测试及批准。我们认为，只有将自进化限制于运行框架——指令文本、工具调用逻辑和原语组合——同时固定模型权重，每次适应成为带原因与测试的差异，才可被审查。基于此边界，我们给出带一个准入门的双循环引擎，在部署前写入哈希链记录，并在模拟中测量该门；实验使用模拟智能体和带种子搜索提议器，而非语言模型。在三类监督规则重新解释、三个强度等级、每格十个随机种子中，门控闭环从 7,449 个候选修改接纳 144 个，没有一个恶化留出历史错误；在所有低、中强度条件下，不增加漏报就将假阳性率恢复至预言机水平。若把准入门换为无约束系统使用的检查方式——近期轨迹可见错误更少——相同闭环会接纳 309 个有害修改，并在 90 次运行中的 49 次中使漏报率保持在 10% 以上：假阳性下降只是因为筛查放松。若仍用变化前标签评估，准入门会拒绝全部候选，因此重新解释必须编码成能重标历史的规则。参数和范围变化可局部修复，结构变化只能替换原语；最高强度结构变化时，门的固定容差在一半种子中阻止了正确替换。我们将机制对应到欧盟 AI Act 对高风险信贷评分的规定，并指出 2026 年 4 月美国模型风险指南将智能体 AI 排除在范围之外。
2610.10629.title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
2610.10629.mechanism_en: Two loops revise instructions, tool calls, and primitive composition. Hash-chained records are written before admission; relabeled history and held-out history support evaluation.
2610.10629.result_en: Simulated-agent and seeded-search proposer experiments admit only 144 of 7,449 candidates, with no added held-out-history errors. The ungated control admits 309 harmful changes.
2610.10629.boundary_en: The authors explicitly use no LLM in this experiment, so the evidence is simulation. Fixed tolerance can also reject correct repairs at the strongest structural-change level.

2610.13912.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
2610.13912.authors: Taoyong Cui, Pinxian Zeng, Wanghan Xu, Hao Xiao, Shuhan Xue, Qiang Gao, Wanli Ouyang, Pheng Ann Heng, Zhenfei Yin, Yingcheng Wu, Ling Yang
2610.13912.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
2610.13912.affiliation: PhAI Labs / Chinese University of Hong Kong / University of Macau / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Fudan University / University of Oxford / Stanford University / Peking University
2610.13912.mechanism_en: Observed feedback updates policies or workflows and conditionally adapts the world model; component and compatibility checks govern retention for later interaction.
2610.13912.result_en: With a fixed coder, repair success rises 26.3% → 29.2% → 31.2%; laboratory planning improves 21.80% → 46.01% across five policy versions.
2610.13912.boundary_en: Domain results use different settings and budgets. Retained pair updates support a finite recursive loop, not indefinite acceleration or independently reproduced gains.
2610.13912.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在把交互经验转化为持久改进，但外部反馈成本高昂，而且随着策略演化，世界模型的预测可能变得不可靠。我们提出 RSI-Anything，这是一个建立在 JEPA-Anything 之上的跨领域框架，利用预测式世界模型指导行动与学习数据选择。观测反馈推动策略或工作流改进，以及有条件的世界模型适配；组件检查和兼容性检查决定是否保留更新后的策略—模型组合。在多种计算与科学领域，RSI-Anything 展示了显著收益。在代码修复中，保持编码器固定，在测试使用量相当时，成功率从静态验证器的 26.3%，提高到预测式选择的 29.2%，并在世界模型适配后达到 31.2%。GUI 评估显示任务完成率更高，平均动作数减少 39.4%。经过五个连续策略版本，实验室规划得分从 21.80% 增至 46.01%，超过原来的两倍。在反应优化中，相同的 40 次实验预算下，RSI-Anything 的平均最佳观测产率达到 96.15%，贝叶斯优化为 82.16%。一个端到端免疫科学应用进一步把工作流演化和预测建模与治疗假设生成相连接。这些结果展示了预测式世界模型和保留的系统更新如何在不同环境中支持递归改进。
2610.13912.image_caption: Figure 1: RSI-Anything overview. Building on the cross-domain predictive foundation of JEPA-Anything, RSI-Anything uses world-model predictions to support understanding, planning, and action selection across diverse tasks. Interaction feedback drives policy or workflow updates and conditional world-model adaptation. Component and compatibility checks determine which policy–model pair is retained to guide the next round of interaction and learning, closing the recursive self-improvement loop.

2610.13025.title: Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution
2610.13025.authors: Chejian Xu, Shujian Zhang, Wenxuan Zhou, John Lambert, Beck Chen, Bo Li, Andrew Hard, Rajiv Mathews
2610.13025.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents are increasingly used to improve language model systems without human intervention through either weight updates or harness improvements. Existing approaches typically pursue these directions separately: some methods update model weights using self-generated experience, while others rewrite the harness that defines how an agent uses prompts, tools, context, and execution feedback. However, these approaches overlook the relationship between model weights and the agent harness. To connect these processes and ensure effective and smooth agent self-evolving, we propose Evo$^2$, a framework for weight-harness co-evolution. For harness updates, we design a unified dual-role pipeline that a single policy serves as both a Proposer, which writes harness edits, and a Reflector, which diagnoses their effects and guides revision. For weight updates, harness modifications and their execution outcomes guide the training of both the Proposer and the Reflector. We further develop EvoTIDE, a training pipeline that recovers usable trajectories through edit extraction and prefix continuation, then combines SFT with interleaved GRPO across the two roles. Extensive experiments across three coding benchmarks demonstrate that Evo$^2$ significantly outperforms existing self-evolution methods. It achieves 82.1% on Polyglot and 48.3% on SWE-bench Verified, compared with 62.6% and 41.0% for the strongest baseline, respectively. We also show that the evolved harnesses transfer to different tasks without further evolution and rank first in cross-benchmark evaluations. Our dual-role harness improvement framework is also able to extend to self-evolution with proprietary models, improving a GPT-5-mini agent's performance from 24.4% to 48.3%. These results demonstrate the applicability of the framework Evo$^2$ across domains and its broad transferability across models and tasks.
2610.13025.affiliation: Google DeepMind / University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
2610.13025.mechanism_en: A shared policy proposes and diagnoses harness edits; edit outcomes train both roles through recovered trajectories, SFT, and interleaved GRPO. Updated weights drive later harness search.
2610.13025.result_en: Polyglot reaches 82.1% versus 62.6%; SWE-bench Verified reaches 48.3% versus 41.0% for the strongest baseline.
2610.13025.boundary_en: Separate gains from weight training, harness search, and additional trajectory exposure. Cross-benchmark transfer does not establish unlimited co-evolution.
2610.13025.abstract_zh: 自进化智能体越来越多地通过权重更新或运行框架改进，在无人干预的情况下改善语言模型系统。现有方法通常分别处理这两条路径：一些方法利用自生成经验更新模型权重，另一些则改写决定智能体如何使用提示、工具、上下文和执行反馈的运行框架。然而，它们忽略了模型权重与运行框架之间的关系。为连接这两个过程并实现有效、平稳的自进化，我们提出权重—框架共同演化框架 Evo²。对于框架更新，我们设计统一的双角色流水线，由同一策略同时充当编写框架修改的 Proposer，以及诊断修改效果并指导修订的 Reflector。对于权重更新，框架修改及其执行结果指导两个角色的训练。我们进一步提出 EvoTIDE，通过编辑提取和前缀续写恢复可用轨迹，并把 SFT 与两个角色交错进行的 GRPO 相结合。三个代码基准上的广泛实验表明，Evo² 显著优于现有自进化方法。在 Polyglot 上达到 82.1%，在 SWE-bench Verified 上达到 48.3%，最强基线分别为 62.6% 和 41.0%。演化后的框架无需进一步进化就能迁移到其他任务，并在跨基准评估中排名第一。双角色框架改进也能扩展到专有模型，使 GPT-5-mini 智能体的表现从 24.4% 提高到 48.3%。这些结果展示了 Evo² 在不同领域的适用性，以及跨模型、跨任务的广泛迁移能力。
2610.13025.image_caption: Figure 1: Weight-harness co-evolution in Evo 2 . A shared Proposer–Reflector policy evolves the agent harness. Harness edits and execution outcomes provide training experience for the policy, whose updated weights guide subsequent search. Crossover searching transfers useful strategies between branches.

2610.12789.title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
2610.12789.authors: Janet Wang, Jiang Guo, Yi Xiang, Jiaqing Yuan, Mingwen Dong, Hideo Kobayashi, Shuaichen Chang, Chandan K. Reddy, Jiarong Jiang
2610.12789.abstract_en: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated. We study a complementary axis of self-evolution: evolving those beliefs during deployment. Such beliefs can support multiple tasks, but incorrect ones can also propagate across them. We introduce EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses. Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation. Later observations and controlled experiments provide independent validation before a rule can guide predictions or plans within its supported scope. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as the environment changes. The language model remains frozen, and each rule remains linked to its evidence and the decisions it changes. Across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, EvoBelief improves task performance and reuses learned rules across tasks. On ALFWorld without actor-side transition memory, it improves success over the matched Frozen World Model by 23.9% and 31.3% with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, respectively. On MiniGrid, it revises stale rules and recovers after unannounced dynamics changes. In DiscoveryWorld's Reactor Lab, it discovers and validates quantitative laws, completing 83.3% of Normal-tier and 58.3% of Challenge-tier instances, versus 0% for each evaluated baseline. These results demonstrate self-improvement through testable, revisable environment knowledge rather than model-parameter updates.
2610.12789.update_target: Persistent, falsifiable environment rules; frozen LLM
2610.12789.mechanism_en: Unexpected outcomes trigger hypotheses; observations and controlled experiments validate rules. Counterexamples narrow or retire them before subsequent predictions and plans.
2610.12789.result_en: ALFWorld gains over matched frozen world models are 23.9% and 31.3%; Reactor Lab reaches 83.3% Normal and 58.3% Challenge completion.
2610.12789.boundary_en: Rules are scoped to supporting evidence; validation and changed dynamics need separate audits. No model-weight update is claimed.
2610.12789.abstract_zh: 自进化 LLM 智能体通常通过积累经验、反思或技能改善行动方式。但即使具备较强操作能力，当关于环境动力学的信念不完整、错误或过时时，也可能失败。我们研究一种互补的自进化方向：在部署期间演化这些信念。信念可以支持多个任务，错误信念也可能跨任务传播。我们提出 EvoBelief，把环境知识表示为可证伪假设的自进化世界模型。意外结果和影响决策的未知因素触发假设形成。在规则能够在其支持范围内指导预测或规划之前，后续观察和受控实验提供独立验证。环境变化时，反例缩小规则适用范围或使规则退出。语言模型保持冻结，每条规则始终关联其证据及所改变的决策。在涵盖静态动力学、隐藏漂移和科学发现的四个基准上，EvoBelief 提高任务表现，并跨任务复用学得的规则。在不提供行动侧转移记忆的 ALFWorld 中，使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 和 GPT-5.4 时，相比匹配的冻结世界模型，成功率分别提高 23.9% 和 31.3%。在 MiniGrid 中，它修订过时规则，并在未预告的动力学变化后恢复。在 DiscoveryWorld 的 Reactor Lab 中，它发现并验证定量规律，完成 Normal 级实例的 83.3% 和 Challenge 级实例的 58.3%，所有被评估基线在两级均为 0%。这些结果展示了通过可测试、可修订的环境知识实现自改进，而不是更新模型参数。
2610.12789.image_caption: Figure 1: Illustrative example. (a) Following its frozen prior, a capable agent heats compound X to 100 ∘ C and gets decomposition products. (b) The mismatch triggers a hypothesis, which controlled experiments test. (c) The verified belief is stored in the persistent world model W W and changes later actions in the original task and in new ones, without any parameter update. Based on the updated belief, the agent avoids gas chromatography (GC), whose operating temperature exceeds the supported range, and correctly chooses to use liquid chromatography (LC) instead.

2610.13194.title: JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models
2610.13194.authors: Mengdi Liu, Chenghao Jia, Hong Chang, Mingjie He, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen
2610.13194.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.13194.abstract_en: Long-horizon autonomous research has shown promise in accelerating scientific progress through sustained cycles of hypothesis generation, implementation, and validation. However, this Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm relies on reactive trial-and-error, where costly and time-consuming executions introduce severe feedback delays, throttling evolutionary progress under explosively expanding search space. To address this challenge, we propose JANUS, a framework that unifies future outcomes forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Within an evolving graph, the research agent proposes candidates while world model scores them by forecasting value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility, then accordingly selects, refines, or prunes branches prior to execution. After receiving ground-truth feedback, JANUS distills experience into evolving skills: hierarchical skills for research agent, exploration-strategy skills for world model, and their coordination protocols. This mechanism enables continual co-evolution: the research agent sharpens candidate generation while the world model refines its predictive judgment over extended horizons. Extensive evaluations on MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks demonstrate that JANUS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving both higher evolving efficiency and ceiling.
2610.13194.affiliation: Institute of Computing Technology, CAS / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
2610.13194.update_target: Research skills, predictive judgment, and coordination protocols
2610.13194.mechanism_en: Forecast candidate value, information gain, and exploration utility before execution; ground-truth outcomes update research-agent skills and world-model exploration strategies.
2610.13194.result_en: MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks show higher evolutionary efficiency and attainable performance than evaluated baselines.
2610.13194.boundary_en: The abstract supplies no numerical headline. Count forecasting, execution, and skill updates in the same budget; prediction quality can drift with search.
2610.13194.abstract_zh: 长周期自主研究通过持续的假设生成、实现和验证，有望加速科学进步。但这种“生成—执行—反馈”范式依赖被动试错：昂贵且耗时的执行导致严重反馈延迟，在爆炸式扩张的搜索空间中限制进化进展。为此，我们提出 JANUS，以共同演化的世界模型驱动“预测—验证—进化”循环，统一未来结果预测与历史经验反思。在演化图中，研究智能体提出候选，世界模型预测其价值提升、信息增益和探索效用，进而在执行前选择、细化或剪除分支。得到真实反馈后，JANUS 把经验蒸馏为不断演化的技能：研究智能体的层级技能、世界模型的探索策略技能，以及双方的协作协议。这一机制支持持续共同演化：研究智能体改善候选生成，世界模型在长周期内改善预测判断。在 MLS-Bench-Lite 和真实研究任务上的广泛评估表明，JANUS 显著优于当前最先进基线，在进化效率和能力上限两方面均更高。
2610.13194.image_caption: Figure 1: Conceptual comparison between recent works and JANUS. Unlike traditional Generate–Execute–Feedback frameworks that suffer from execution bottlenecks, JANUS introduces a Predict–Verify–Evolve loop to forecast outcomes, prune unpromising branches, and reuse past experience. Consequently, JANUS establishes a superior Evolving Scaling Law , significantly improving both evolving efficiency and the attainable evolving ceiling over reactive baselines.

2610.13376.title: EndoRSI: Physical-Evidence-Driven Recursive Improvement of Endoscopic Robot Policies
2610.13376.authors: Chi Kit Ng, Yidong Zhang, Tianchun Wu, Siu Hing Lui, Hanlin Zhao, Huxin Gao, Hongliang Ren
2610.13376.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is beginning to automate scientific discovery, yet physical robot-policy research still relies on scientists and engineers to interpret experimental failures and decide how controllers should be revised. We present EndoRSI (Endoscopic Recursive Self-Improvement), a human-governed, self-improving robotic research system in which the embedded EndoForge coding agent iteratively develops and refines endoscopic robot policies using evidence from physical experiments. Physical execution remains isolated within a safety-constrained runtime under human authorisation. In motorised endoscopy, validation evidence first caused the agent to reject an initial action representation, while subsequent physical experiments falsified an offline-supported insertion strategy by revealing hazardous closed-loop behaviour absent from the source data. Failed physical rollouts were then incorporated into policy revision; insertion success subsequently increased from 2/21 in the first generation to 17/21 in the fourth. The frozen final policy retained competence across visual and hardware shifts and was the best performing autonomous policy across six independent ex-vivo porcine specimens. These results show that physical robot interaction can serve as experimental evidence for agent-driven robot policy research.
2610.13376.update_target: Endoscopic robot policies revised by a coding research agent
2610.13376.mechanism_en: Physical failures falsify offline-supported strategies; EndoForge incorporates failed rollouts into later policy revisions. Human-authorized execution stays in a separate constrained runtime.
2610.13376.result_en: Insertion improves from 2/21 in generation one to 17/21 in generation four; the frozen final policy is evaluated on six independent ex-vivo porcine specimens.
2610.13376.boundary_en: This is human-governed physical evidence, not unattended clinical deployment. Ex-vivo specimens and visual/hardware shifts have a defined scope.
2610.13376.abstract_zh: 人工智能开始自动化科学发现，但物理机器人策略研究仍依赖科学家和工程师解释实验失败并决定如何修订控制器。我们提出 EndoRSI（内窥镜递归自我改进），这是一个由人类治理的自改进机器人研究系统，其中嵌入的 EndoForge 编码智能体利用物理实验证据，反复开发和改进内窥镜机器人策略。物理执行始终隔离在经人类授权、具有安全约束的运行系统中。在电动内窥镜实验中，验证证据首先促使智能体拒绝初始动作表示；后续物理实验发现源数据未呈现的危险闭环行为，否证了此前得到离线证据支持的插入策略。失败的物理轨迹随后进入策略修订，插入成功次数从第一代的 2/21 提高到第四代的 17/21。冻结的最终策略在视觉与硬件变化下仍保持能力，并在六个独立离体猪标本上成为表现最好的自主策略。这些结果表明，物理机器人交互可以作为智能体驱动机器人策略研究的实验证据。
2610.13376.image_caption: Figure 1: EndoForge connects task definition, policy research, physical execution and evidence-driven revision. Existing tracking and navigation data provide complementary source skills. The coding agent analyses data, results and code and prepares candidate policies. Human-authorised execution occurs through a separate safety-constrained runtime. Physical outcomes and human feedback inform subsequent research and transfer evaluation.

2610.12794.title: Meta-Reflective Evolution Effectively Improves Production AI Systems
2610.12794.authors: Seung Won Wilson Yoo, Chang Zeng, Aditi Somayajula, Sahithi Ankireddy, Rohan Kosalge, Avishree Khare, John Mitchell, Aditya G. Parameswaran, Rajhans Samdani, Anupam Datta
2610.12794.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.12794.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-guided evolutionary optimization has successfully improved prompts, programs, and even entire AI systems. Most optimization methods select a candidate from the search frontier, then mutate it in one LLM pass based only on its failures. This focus on the frontier can stall on production AI systems, where isolated failures reveal little about complex, hidden interactions. We introduce CoCoEvolve (Cortex Code Evolve), an evolutionary optimizer built around what we call meta-reflection, wherein an agentic mutator (Cortex Code) selectively retrieves evidence from the entire evolutionary history and probes the live system before verifying and proposing mutations. We apply CoCoEvolve to optimize three classes of production AI systems: data agents, LLM-powered data pipelines, and data engineering workflows. On DABStep, CoCoEvolve tops the public leaderboard, reaching 92.8% held-out hard accuracy compared to 78.4% for Meta-Harness and 30.4% for GEPA under matched conditions. Across six LLM data pipeline workloads, it outperforms every evaluated baseline. On data-eng-bench, CoCoEvolve lifts test-set solve rate from 59.1% to 77.4%, past the best baseline of 73.6%. It also has 11 percentage points higher accuracy than GEPA on HotpotQA while remaining competitive with specialized optimizers on established mathematical and systems benchmarks. Matched ablations confirm that each component of CoCoEvolve contributes to these gains, demonstrating the value of meta-reflection for optimizing production AI systems.
2610.12794.affiliation: Snowflake / University of Massachusetts Amherst / Stanford University / UC Berkeley / University of Pennsylvania
2610.12794.update_target: Production-agent specifications, pipeline programs, and workflows
2610.12794.mechanism_en: An agentic mutator retrieves full evolutionary history and probes the live system before testing and proposing retained program mutations.
2610.12794.result_en: DABStep held-out hard accuracy is 92.8% versus 78.4% for Meta-Harness and 30.4% for GEPA; data-eng-bench rises 59.1% → 77.4%.
2610.12794.boundary_en: The optimizer remains an external mechanism; optimized production systems should not be described as autonomous optimizer-weight evolution.
2610.12794.abstract_zh: LLM 引导的进化优化已经成功改进提示、程序乃至整个 AI 系统。大多数优化方法从搜索前沿选择候选，再仅依据该候选的失败，用一次 LLM 调用进行变异。这种聚焦前沿的方式可能在生产 AI 系统上停滞，因为孤立失败很难揭示复杂、隐藏的相互作用。我们提出 CoCoEvolve（Cortex Code Evolve），一种围绕“元反思”构建的进化优化器：智能体式变异器 Cortex Code 有选择地检索整个进化历史的证据，并探查运行中的系统，然后验证和提出变异。我们用 CoCoEvolve 优化三类生产 AI 系统：数据智能体、LLM 驱动的数据流水线和数据工程工作流。在 DABStep 上，它以 92.8% 的留出困难任务准确率登顶公开排行榜；匹配条件下，Meta-Harness 为 78.4%，GEPA 为 30.4%。在六种 LLM 数据流水线工作负载上，它优于所有被评估基线。在 data-eng-bench 上，它把测试集解决率从 59.1% 提高到 77.4%，超过最佳基线的 73.6%。在 HotpotQA 上，准确率比 GEPA 高 11 个百分点，同时在已有数学与系统基准上仍能与专门优化器竞争。匹配的消融确认每个组件都对收益作出贡献，展示了元反思在优化生产 AI 系统中的价值。

2610.12593.title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
2610.12593.authors: Wei Yang, Qing Ping, Youzhi Luo, Yawei Wang, Abhishek Kumar, Panpan Xu, Jun Huan
2610.12593.abstract_en: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $\tau^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.
2610.12593.affiliation: University of Southern California / AWS AI
2610.12593.update_target: Synthetic interaction-factor space and allocation, coupled to learner updates
2610.12593.mechanism_en: Learner feedback changes synthesis directions and promotes newly discovered factors into explicit controls; Designer and Planner produce executable experience for further learning.
2610.12593.result_en: Average task success exceeds the strongest synthesis baseline by 13.3 points on tau-squared-Bench and CAR-Bench.
2610.12593.boundary_en: Distinguish expansion of generation controls from simple resampling; verify that downstream gains persist when synthesis and training budgets are matched.
2610.12593.abstract_zh: LLM 的持续改进日益依赖合成经验，但有效的交互式智能体数据合成不仅需要可执行、可验证的轨迹，也需要对当前任务智能体有学习价值的交互。现有方法越来越多地引入环境反馈、数据验证或学习器失败，却仍面临从反馈到决策的缺口：观察到的弱点不能直接说明未来合成应如何改变，或当前合成空间是否能够表示这些弱点。为此，我们提出 EvoSyn，一个由学习反馈驱动的多智能体框架，围绕可修订状态组织合成，明确哪些交互因素可以主动生成，以及应把合成投入分配到哪里。具有专门角色的多智能体系统把学习器反馈转化为合成修订；Designer 分配合成方向，Planner 将其落实为可执行经验。该过程既支持在现有空间内朝薄弱或覆盖不足区域适配，也支持扩大合成空间，把新发现因素提升为显式生成控制。在 τ²-Bench 和 CAR-Bench 上，EvoSyn 的平均任务成功率比最强合成基线高 13.3 点，同时生成更高质量、结构更广泛的合成经验，并发现缺少学习器反馈时遗漏的可控因素。
2610.12593.image_caption: Figure 1: From static synthesis to closed-loop self-evolving agentic synthesis. Existing paradigms improve data quality or adapt within a fixed synthesis space. In contrast, EvoSyn uses learner feedback to revise both the allocation over known factors and the synthesis space itself by introducing new controllable interaction factors.

2610.12536.title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
2610.12536.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)
2610.12536.abstract_en: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.
2610.12536.update_target: An elite archive of executable control programs
2610.12536.mechanism_en: Search evaluations update a fixed-capacity elite table; retained programs guide proposals, edits, and remixes. Held-out episodes do not enter the search loop.
2610.12536.result_en: Candidate medians rise on six tasks; all ten paired held-out endpoints improve on four. Acrobot has six declines and a negative median paired change.
2610.12536.boundary_en: Search-score improvement can coexist with held-out decline. The paper explicitly requires comparisons and ablations to establish relative performance.
2610.12536.abstract_zh: EliteTable 是一种由大语言模型引导的自改进程序搜索算法，使用固定容量的高分解表，指导新提案、现有解的编辑及多个解的混合。我们在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上评估，每个任务搜索十代，每代五十个候选槽位，每个任务进行十次独立初始化的搜索。六个任务的候选分数中位数都从第一代到最后一代上升，所选优胜者的搜索分数中位数在五个任务上上升。在 CartPole-v1 中，十次搜索的所选优胜者均在第一代达到搜索分数上限。在六个任务中的四个任务上，十次配对留出终点评估均有改进。BipedalWalker-v3 和 CarRacing-v3 有提升，但未达到其报告目标。Acrobot-v1 的十次搜索中有六次在留出回合上下降，配对变化中位数为负。结果记录了程序搜索期间的改进，以及部分任务中所选优胜者的收益向新回合的迁移。仍需比较和消融，以确定 EliteTable 的相对表现及各组件贡献。

2610.12668.title: Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning
2610.12668.authors: Yuxin Xiao, Zhiyun Lu, Jianyu Wang, Yangtian Zhang, Yang Song, Qifan Wang, Bailin Wang
2610.12668.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.12668.abstract_en: Language model agents increasingly operate over long interaction streams, requiring online adaptation to distribution shifts through continual learning. However, existing agent harnesses typically either evolve their states only through forward information flow or rely on additional replay or validation data for harness optimization. To address this, we propose ReHarness, a recurrent harness framework for agentic continual learning that complements forward read and write with backward revision under a strictly online streaming protocol. We ask what information could have been captured differently in the harness state to better inform the current instance in the stream. Specifically, after each instance, we leverage the resulting trajectory as feedback to revise the reflections retrieved for that instance, thereby propagating feedback backward through the textual harness state. Across three continual learning benchmarks and three language model backbones, ReHarness consistently outperforms strong raw-context baselines, memory- and reflection-based methods, and prompt optimization approaches. Further analysis shows that ReHarness produces source-grounded and meaningful revisions, corrects overgeneralized or outdated experience under distribution shifts, and improves both stability and plasticity during continual learning.
2610.12668.affiliation: MIT / Meta MRS Research / Yale University
2610.12668.update_target: Retrieved reflections in a persistent textual harness
2610.12668.mechanism_en: After each streaming instance, its trajectory revises the reflections retrieved for that instance, sending feedback backward into harness state for later use.
2610.12668.result_en: Across three continual-learning benchmarks and three backbones, ReHarness outperforms raw-context, memory/reflection, and prompt-optimization comparisons.
2610.12668.boundary_en: This updates external reflections, not backbone weights. Check revision provenance, distribution-shift adaptation, and cost of growing retrieved context.
2610.12668.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体越来越多地运行于长交互流中，需要通过持续学习在线适应分布变化。但现有运行框架通常只通过前向信息流演化状态，或依赖额外重放或验证数据来优化框架。为此，我们提出 ReHarness，一个用于智能体持续学习的循环运行框架，在严格在线流式协议下，以向后修订补充前向读取与写入。我们追问：此前应如何不同地记录框架状态中的信息，才能更好地指导当前样本？具体而言，每个样本结束后，我们用其产生的轨迹作为反馈，修订为该样本检索出的反思，从而通过文本框架状态向后传播反馈。在三个持续学习基准和三个语言模型主干上，ReHarness 持续优于强原始上下文基线、记忆与反思方法及提示优化方法。进一步分析表明，它产生有来源依据且有意义的修订，纠正分布变化下过度泛化或过时的经验，并同时提高持续学习的稳定性和可塑性。

Revisions diminish as reflections stabilize before the distribution shift, then rise afterward to update outdated reflections. (b) Top- k k scaling on CL-Bench with Claude. ReHarness improves sharply up to k = 5 k=5 and stabilizes for moderate k k , while larger values yield diminishing returns and higher cost.

2610.12813.title: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
2610.12813.authors: Duy Nguyen, Lesly Miculicich, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Shuo Li, Krishnamurthy Dj Dvijotham, Mohit Bansal, Tomas Pfister, Long T. Le
2610.12813.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.12813.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions are executed. However, safety and security requirements are rarely complete before deployment, so guardrails need to keep adapting as new risks emerge. Existing adaptive guardrails learn from deployment experience, but they usually apply safety policies through LLM inference, which can lead to inconsistent decisions and ambiguous policy interpretations. Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. Finally, an evidence-aware authority layer activates a verified rule only when it has enough supporting evidence, so uncertain updates cannot directly affect guardrail decisions. Across ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, VEPA consistently outperforms baselines while expanding the scope of deterministic formal-policy enforcement. These gains also hold under more challenging deployment conditions, including mixed streams, corrupted feedback, and longer horizons.
2610.12813.affiliation: Google Cloud AI Research / University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill / Google DeepMind
2610.12813.mechanism_en: Deployment failures guide LLM policy patches; deterministic structural/conflict checks and an evidence-aware activation layer gate updates and preserve previously correct behavior.
2610.12813.result_en: VEPA outperforms baselines on ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, including corrupted-feedback and long-horizon conditions.
2610.12813.boundary_en: Structural validity is distinct from complete semantic safety. Evidence requirements and the tested threat distribution bound the claim.
2610.12813.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体越来越多地操作私人文档、可修改系统状态等敏感资源，可能带来严重安全风险。因此，运行时护栏应在可能不可逆的智能体动作执行前，作出可检查、可复现且确定性的允许或拒绝决定。但安全需求很少在部署前就完整确定，护栏需要随新风险出现不断适配。现有自适应护栏从部署经验学习，但通常通过 LLM 推理应用安全策略，导致决策不一致和解释含糊；形式化护栏则执行确定性策略，却通常依赖部署前或任务专用策略，缺少适应新风险的机制。我们提出 VEPA，用于形式化智能体护栏的经过验证的演化。VEPA 把护栏表示为针对类型化智能体事件的可执行符号规则。在部署过程中，LLM 依据部署反馈提出策略补丁，修复新观察到的失败并保留此前正确行为。随后，确定性验证器只接受结构有效且无冲突的策略。最后，证据感知的权威层只在支持证据足够时启用已验证规则，防止不确定更新直接影响护栏决策。在 ASSEBench-Safety、ASSEBench-Security 和 ATBench 上，VEPA 持续优于基线，同时扩大确定性形式策略的执行范围。这些收益在混合数据流、受损反馈和更长周期等困难部署条件下依然成立。
2610.12813.image_caption: Figure 1: Motivation for evolving formal policy. Static formal policy cannot adapt. Across a sequence of deployment tasks, natural-language memory can accumulate ambiguous or conflicting guidance and overgeneralize from feedback, causing regression on previously correct behavior. In contrast, VEPA represents policy as executable symbolic rules, verifies new rules for conflict-freedom, and preserves previously correct rules while adapting to newly observed cases.

2610.12598.title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
2610.12598.authors: Yiran Wu, Andrew Zhao, Yurui Chang, Qingyun Wu, Xuan Feng
2610.12598.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench-Live show consistent improvements across the evaluated Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B configurations, supporting using the policy's own comparative judgments as a complementary learning signal for training software engineering agents.
2610.12598.affiliation: Pennsylvania State University / AG2AI / Microsoft Research
2610.12598.update_target: Auxiliary reward signals and coding-policy weights
2610.12598.mechanism_en: The current policy compares debugging behavior among trajectories sharing a task and verifier outcome; bounded auxiliary rewards preserve pass/fail ordering during learning.
2610.12598.result_en: Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B configurations improve consistently on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench-Live.
2610.12598.boundary_en: Self-comparison may share policy blind spots. The binary verifier remains the anchor; no separately trained reward model or extra environment interactions are required.
2610.12598.abstract_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）通过可执行测试，为软件工程智能体提供可靠监督，但二元奖励无法区分调试质量显著不同的轨迹。我们研究当前策略能否评判自己的轨迹，并在不单独训练奖励模型的情况下，用这些判断提高任务表现。为此，我们提出行为自奖励（BSR），一种奖励细化方法，复用当前策略，比较同一任务且验证器结果相同的轨迹中可观察的调试行为。BSR 把成对偏好汇总为任务局部分数，转换成有界辅助奖励，在保留验证器定义的通过/失败排序的同时引入奖励对比。这利用已收集轨迹提供额外监督，无需新的环境交互。在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench-Live 上，被评估的 Qwen3-14B 与 Qwen3-32B 配置均获得一致提升，支持把策略自身的比较判断用作软件工程智能体训练的互补学习信号。

2610.12659.title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
2610.12659.authors: Ximing Lu, Aviral Kumar, Jan Kautz, Yejin Choi, David Acuna
2610.12659.abstract_en: Data-centric scaling of RLVR has focused on collecting or generating verifiable training problems. However, corpus size alone does not determine whether the dataset provides a useful learning signal for a target policy. To guide the synthesis of effective RLVR data, we experimentally characterize dataset effectiveness as a function of its problems, the target policy, and the training rollout budget. Under this characterization, we show that a large open-source math corpus pooled from widely used RLVR datasets falls almost entirely into a zero-advantage trap: for a fixed target policy and rollout budget, roughly 88% of its problems are solved in every rollout or failed in every rollout. Filtering concentrates what remains, but it can only select, discarding the hard problems. Effective synthetic problems should therefore require the reasoning operations and compositions required to solve those hard problems. Yet their difficulty must be calibrated, so that some rollouts succeed, some fail, and at least one correct solution fits within the training budget. Prompting a teacher to vary hard problems directly does not achieve this. Guided by these empirical principles, we introduce MagicBeanStalk, a top-down decomposition and bottom-up recursive data-synthesis algorithm that grows seed problems into families of substantively new, policy- and budget-calibrated training problems while preserving the seeds' reasoning blueprints. Across 8 math benchmarks, continual RLVR on MagicBeanStalk problems improves gpt-oss-120b from 61.2 to 69.8 (+8.6) and DeepSeek v4Flash from 72.4 to 77.9 (+5.4) on a 16K-token budget. Training on the full 78K source corpus improves by only +1.1 and its best filtered real data subset by +5.8. In finance, we synthesize over 14K verifiable problems from only 340 solutions and improve over base by 6.9 and 2.4 points on SecQue and FinanceBench, respectively.
2610.12659.affiliation: University of Washington / Carnegie Mellon University / Stanford University / NVIDIA
2610.12659.update_target: Policy- and budget-calibrated synthetic RLVR problems
2610.12659.mechanism_en: Top-down decomposition and bottom-up synthesis preserve seed reasoning blueprints while constructing problems with mixed rollout outcomes for a target policy and budget.
2610.12659.result_en: About 88% of the source corpus is zero-advantage; continual training raises gpt-oss-120b 61.2 → 69.8 and DeepSeek v4Flash 72.4 → 77.9.
2610.12659.boundary_en: Recursive problem construction is an enabling data mechanism. It does not alone establish autonomous evolution of the optimizer or an unlimited policy–data loop.
2610.12659.abstract_zh: 以数据为中心的 RLVR 扩展主要关注收集或生成可验证训练题目。但仅有语料规模，并不能决定数据集是否为目标策略提供有效学习信号。为指导有效 RLVR 数据合成，我们通过实验把数据集有效性刻画为题目、目标策略和训练 rollout 预算的函数。在此刻画下，一个汇集常用 RLVR 数据集的大型开源数学语料几乎完全陷入零优势陷阱：对固定策略和 rollout 预算，约 88% 题目在所有 rollout 中都成功，或全部失败。过滤可以集中剩余题目，却只能选择并丢弃难题。因此，有效合成题目应要求解这些难题所需的推理操作和组合，同时校准难度，使部分 rollout 成功、部分失败，并至少有一个正确解能在训练预算内完成。直接提示教师变换难题无法做到这一点。依据这些实验原则，我们提出 MagicBeanStalk，自顶向下分解、自底向上递归合成，把种子题扩展为实质新颖、按策略和预算校准的题目族，同时保留种子推理蓝图。在八个数学基准上，使用此类题目持续 RLVR，在 16K token 预算下把 gpt-oss-120b 从 61.2 提高到 69.8（+8.6），把 DeepSeek v4Flash 从 72.4 提高到 77.9（+5.4）。用完整 78K 源语料训练仅提高 +1.1，最优过滤真实数据子集提高 +5.8。在金融领域，我们仅从 340 个解合成超过 14K 个可验证题目，相比基础模型在 SecQue 和 FinanceBench 上分别提高 6.9 和 2.4 点。

2610.13285.title: BoundaryEvo: Data-Model Co-Evolution at the Capability Boundary for Long-Chain Reasoning Distillation
2610.13285.authors: Jiaming Su, Suorong Yang, Xudong Li, Tengchao Yang, Peng Ye
2610.13285.abstract_en: Distilling long-chain reasoning trajectories from large teacher models provides an effective way to improve the reasoning ability of small language models. However, existing methods typically select a fixed training set before distillation, overlooking that the usefulness of a reasoning example changes as the student evolves. This mismatch becomes especially costly when only a small number of teacher trajectories can be used for training. Besides, examples already mastered provide little new supervision, while examples far beyond the capability of student may be difficult to learn from. Training data should therefore adapt as model capability evolves, yet reliable data selection is difficult when the student is initially weak. To address these challenges, our key idea is to first establish the basic reasoning capability and then adapt the training data to the evolving capability boundary of the student. We propose BoundaryEvo, a two-stage data--model co-evolution framework. In Capability Priming, we directly distill a small set of teacher-generated long reasoning trajectories without using a separate model to judge and filter them, allowing the student to acquire an initial reasoning capability before capability-aware data selection. In Capability-Boundary Co-Evolution, we repeatedly select questions that the current student has not mastered but the expert can reliably solve, and update the training data as the student evolves. With only 1,000 training examples, BoundaryEvo consistently outperforms static and dynamic data selection baselines across 11 reasoning benchmarks, raising the original Qwen3.5-4B accuracy from 62.9 to 75.3 on IMO-AnswerBench and from 26.8 to 46.0 on AMO-Bench. The code and data will be made publicly available.
2610.13285.affiliation: Shanghai AI Laboratory / Nanjing University / Tongji University / Chinese University of Hong Kong
2610.13285.update_target: Student weights and a changing distillation dataset
2610.13285.mechanism_en: Prime the student with teacher trajectories, then repeatedly select questions the current student has not mastered and the expert reliably solves; refresh data as capability changes.
2610.13285.result_en: With 1,000 examples, Qwen3.5-4B rises 62.9 → 75.3 on IMO-AnswerBench and 26.8 → 46.0 on AMO-Bench across an 11-benchmark evaluation.
2610.13285.boundary_en: The external expert supplies supervision; data–model co-evolution is not self-generated verification. Code and data are promised rather than verified as released.
2610.13285.abstract_zh: 从大型教师模型蒸馏长链推理轨迹，是改善小型语言模型推理能力的有效方式。但现有方法通常在蒸馏前固定训练集，忽略了推理样本的价值会随学生演化而变化。当只能使用少量教师轨迹时，这种错配尤其昂贵：已掌握样本提供的新监督很少，远超学生能力的样本又可能难以学习。因此，训练数据应随模型能力适配，但学生初始很弱时，可靠数据选择很困难。我们的核心想法是先建立基本推理能力，再按学生不断变化的能力边界适配训练数据。我们提出 BoundaryEvo，两阶段的数据—模型共同演化框架。在能力启动阶段，直接蒸馏少量教师生成的长推理轨迹，不用另一个模型评判和过滤，使学生在能力感知选择之前获得初始推理能力。在能力边界共同演化阶段，反复选择当前学生尚未掌握、但专家可以可靠解决的问题，并随学生演化更新训练数据。仅用 1,000 个训练样本，BoundaryEvo 在 11 个推理基准上持续优于静态和动态数据选择基线，把原 Qwen3.5-4B 在 IMO-AnswerBench 上的准确率从 62.9 提高到 75.3，在 AMO-Bench 上从 26.8 提高到 46.0。代码和数据将在未来公开。
