(a-c) Comparison with static distillation and error-driven acquisition, BoundaryEvo dynamically adapts supervision according to the evolving capability boundary of the student model. (d) BoundaryEvo-4B consistently outperforms strong baselines across various reasoning benchmarks.

2610.12984.title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
2610.12984.authors: Yuqi Huang, Hui Li, Yifei Cao, Zikun Cai, Tianci Xie, Yangfan Gao, Pinxue Guo, Chaoyun Zhang, Bingxuan Li, Rui Zheng, Hang Yan, Ning Liao
2610.12984.abstract_en: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow rules from task-specific details. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework's infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation. Its 350 demonstrations are screened for completeness and task success. We then propose an agentic skill-induction method that inspects evidence on demand to produce reusable skills capturing workflow rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. When the same four execution models are equipped with skills induced by each method under shared execution settings, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates. Mean score improvements over the corresponding No Skill baseline are 4.67--10.54 points on MyPCBench Bounded Action and 3.11--7.50 points on a 286-task subset of OSWorld-Verified. Our code and data are available at this https URL .
2610.12984.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Fudan University / Nanyang Technological University / Zhejiang University / Shanghai Qiji Zhifeng
2610.12984.update_target: Reusable GUI workflow skills induced from human demonstrations
2610.12984.mechanism_en: Synchronized screen, input-event, and accessibility evidence supports on-demand skill induction of rules, dependencies, and completion checks, then reuse by fixed execution models.
2610.12984.result_en: WorkDemo-350 contains 350 screened demonstrations; mean score gains are 4.67–10.54 on MyPCBench and 3.11–7.50 on a 286-task OSWorld subset.
2610.12984.boundary_en: Included as a skill-acquisition mechanism. The abstract does not show an autonomous repeated skill-revision loop; demonstrations provide human knowledge.
2610.12984.abstract_zh: 计算机操作智能体能够执行越来越复杂的 GUI 任务，但陌生软件和需要人类领域知识的工作流仍具挑战。人类演示通过相同 GUI 交互空间传递操作知识，但复用要求结合上下文解释动作，并把工作流规则与具体任务细节分开。我们提出 Work2Skill，捕获人类 GUI 经验以归纳可复用智能体技能。基础设施 WorkRecorder 对齐屏幕录制、鼠标键盘事件及可用的无障碍树信息。我们用它构建 WorkDemo-350，首个面向可复用技能归纳和下游评估的同步多模态人类桌面 GUI 演示数据集。350 个演示均经过完整性和任务成功筛查。随后提出智能体式技能归纳方法，按需检查证据，生成包含工作流规则、步骤依赖和完成检查的可复用技能。在共享执行设置下，同样四个执行模型分别使用各方法归纳的技能时，Work2Skill 获得最高分数和成功率。相比对应的 No Skill 基线，在 MyPCBench Bounded Action 上平均分提高 4.67–10.54 点，在 OSWorld-Verified 的 286 任务子集上提高 3.11–7.50 点。代码与数据可通过原摘要所附链接获取。

2610.13058.title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
2610.13058.authors: Ziang Ye, Wentao Shi, Lei Chen, Zhengzhou Cai, Yu Wang, Zhiyuan Yao, Zihan Wang, Xierui Song, Fuli Feng, Yixin Cao
2610.13058.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at this https URL .
2610.13058.affiliation: USTC / Shanghai Innovation Institute / Facebook / Zhejiang University / Tsinghua University / Meituan / Fudan University
2610.13058.update_target: Retained branch experience and a shared execution/reflection policy
2610.13058.mechanism_en: Rewind environment state while retaining valid progress and knowledge; State-Anchored GRPO compares continuations and branch-advancement reward trains useful reflection.
2610.13058.result_en: Four interactive benchmarks show that rewind alone has limited or negative benefit, whereas combining rewind with experience reuse improves exploration.
2610.13058.boundary_en: Reuse is within an ongoing task. Rewind feasibility, replay cost, and policy training must be separated from cross-task persistent improvement.
2610.13058.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体越来越多地运行于长周期环境，早期错误可能引发连锁失败并使其陷入死路。因此，智能体需要主动从这类状态恢复，并把探索经验转化为后续决策指导。我们提出 ReTRAIL，使智能体能够把环境回退到较早状态，同时保留有效进展，并带着从放弃的探索中学到的知识继续前进。环境状态向后移动，而智能体知识持续向前积累。ReTRAIL 用两种互补信号训练共享策略：状态锚定 GRPO 比较回访状态的不同后续轨迹以改善执行，分支推进奖励则通过后续探索进展指导反思。在 MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 四个交互基准上，仅加入回退操作收益有限，甚至可能降低表现。相比之下，ReTRAIL 能让智能体从无效状态回退，并利用放弃分支的洞见指导后续探索。这些结果展示了在持续任务内部，把环境回退和经验复用结合起来对长周期任务求解的价值。代码可通过原摘要所附链接获取。
2610.13058.image_caption: Figure 1: Retrospective exploration with retained experience. Multi-episode adaptation (top) restarts the task from s 0 s_{0} after an unsuccessful attempt, carrying retained experience into a new episode. In contrast, ReTRAIL (bottom) proactively abandons an unproductive branch, distills its experience, rewinds to an earlier state, and resumes with the retained execution prefix and accumulated experience. Recovery can occur before terminal failure.

2610.13064.title: CB-Orchestrator: Adaptive Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents via Contextual Bandits
2610.13064.authors: Jiahang Sun, Zhiwei Shang, Zhipiao Liu, Hongwei Yang, Guoqing Xie, Shuang Qiu, Zhongxiang Dai
2610.13064.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. In the second stage, we formulate workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, which enables sample-efficient learning by balancing exploration and exploitation, thereby significantly reducing the feedback required for training. During inference, the model adaptively selects the optimal workflow tailored to each query. Evaluations across five diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CB-Orchestrator consistently outperforms all baselines. Notably, on the MATH dataset, CB-Orchestrator achieves better performance than strong recent baselines while reducing training-phase API token overhead by no less than 40.55% and total end-to-end training (including workflow pool generation) token overhead by no less than 29.73%.
2610.13064.affiliation: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / Huawei Technologies / City University of Hong Kong
2610.13064.update_target: An evolved workflow pool and a learned contextual selector
2610.13064.mechanism_en: Evolutionary search constructs candidate workflows; contextual-bandit feedback learns selection through exploration and exploitation, and inference reuses the pool per query.
2610.13064.result_en: On MATH, training-phase API tokens drop at least 40.55%; end-to-end training tokens, including pool generation, drop at least 29.73% versus strong baselines.
2610.13064.boundary_en: Report pool-generation cost separately from selector learning; query-adaptive reuse is not continuous test-time rewriting of the whole harness.
2610.13064.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体通过智能体工作流，在复杂任务上展示出出色能力。但人工设计工作流劳动密集，也缺少适应不同查询的灵活性。自动工作流优化很有前景，却往往在训练阶段收集反馈时消耗昂贵的 API 成本，也不能自适应复用高质量工作流，限制表现和成本效率。我们提出 CB-Orchestrator，把工作流生成与选择解耦。第一阶段用进化搜索构建多样化候选工作流池；第二阶段把工作流选择表示为上下文多臂老虎机问题，通过平衡探索与利用实现样本高效学习，显著减少训练所需反馈。推理时，模型针对每个查询自适应选择最佳工作流。在五个不同基准上，CB-Orchestrator 持续优于所有基线。特别是在 MATH 上，它比近期强基线表现更好，同时将训练阶段 API token 开销降低至少 40.55%，把包括工作流池生成在内的端到端训练 token 开销降低至少 29.73%。

2610.13098.title: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
2610.13098.authors: Yingbo Ma, Kuangshi Ai, Gordon Dai, Chenglong Yu, Chaoli Wang, Hua Shen
2610.13098.abstract_en: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders. Recent agentic systems refine scenes through repeated interaction, but they lack mechanisms to recursively extract actionable evidence from execution traces, overlooking which proposed symbolic edits survived, disappeared, or interfered during program execution. To address this, we propose VETR (Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement), a framework that enables agentic recursive self-improvement over executable world representations for symbolic graphics reasoning. Within each task, VETR retains aligned program/render records with bounded runtime observations and introduces an execution refiner that compiles observed writes and state changes into constrained alternative programs. The refiner validates their endpoints and preservation conditions against captured runtime state; the ordinary visual verifier then assesses goal relevance. Repair construction makes no additional language-model calls, but can require additional executions. Evaluations on BlenderGym (280 tasks) and BlenderBench (27 released tasks) with GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B show that VETR consistently outperforms existing refinement strategies, including BlenderAlchemy and VIGA. Controlled ablations evaluate the contributions of execution refinement and role-asymmetric evidence organization under fixed generator-interaction caps.
2610.13098.affiliation: New York University / University of Notre Dame
2610.13098.update_target: Executable scene programs and aligned execution evidence
2610.13098.mechanism_en: Runtime writes and state changes generate constrained repair programs. Endpoint/preservation checks precede visual goal verification and subsequent scene refinement.
2610.13098.result_en: BlenderGym has 280 tasks and released BlenderBench has 27; VETR beats evaluated refinement strategies under fixed generator-interaction caps.
2610.13098.boundary_en: The loop operates within each task. No extra LLM call for repair construction does not mean no extra execution cost or persistent cross-task learning.
2610.13098.abstract_zh: 用于符号图形推理的视觉智能体依赖可执行世界表示，但最终渲染所提供的监督含糊，限制了持续改进。近期系统通过反复交互细化场景，却缺少从执行轨迹递归提取可行动证据的机制，忽略了哪些符号编辑在程序执行中保留下来、消失或相互干扰。为此，我们提出 VETR（用于细化的已验证执行轨迹），在可执行世界表示上支持智能体式递归自改进。在每个任务内部，VETR 保存对齐的程序/渲染记录和有界运行时观察，并引入执行细化器，把观察到的写入和状态变化编译为受约束的替代程序。细化器依据捕获的运行时状态验证端点和保留条件，随后由常规视觉验证器判断与目标的相关性。修复构建无需额外语言模型调用，但可能需要额外执行。在 BlenderGym 的 280 个任务和 BlenderBench 的 27 个已发布任务上，使用 GPT-5.6-luna 与 Qwen3.8-27B 的评估显示，VETR 持续优于 BlenderAlchemy、VIGA 等现有细化策略。受控消融在固定生成器交互上限下评估执行细化与角色不对称证据组织的贡献。
2610.13098.image_caption: Figure 1: Conceptual overview of VETR. VETR refines scenes through execution-grounded evidence, bridging a scene program, its execution trace, and the realized 3D scene. Given a start and goal image, the system performs iterative updates guided by observed writes and realized bindings. This evidence-supported refinement targets viewpoint alignment, appearance (lighting/material) editing, and geometry and placement adjustments. Runtime checks test supported effects, while visual feedback guides subsequent proposals toward the goal.

2610.13172.title: RoleWorld: Knowledge Transfer in World Modeling with Functional Role Abstractions
2610.13172.authors: Boyuan Xiao, Pu Wang, Ji Feng, Yao-Xiang Ding
2610.13172.abstract_en: World models enable large language model (LLM) agents to anticipate action effects and make informed decisions. For generalization, it is desirable for such world models to transfer efficiently to new environments with similar interaction structure and underlying dynamics. Recent approaches encode world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs, whose compositional structure in principle affords transfer, but still organize such knowledge around environment-specific objects. To address this limitation, we introduce RoleWorld, a symbolic world modeling approach which uses reusable prototypes and environment-specific parameter values as functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. From interaction trajectories, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a skill that guides the actor LLM to use role information in decision making. In a target world, without the teacher, the actor uses this skill together with its current role assignments and parameter estimates, and actively tests a role instance hypothesis through interaction when its uncertainty affects the current decision. Feedback from each action refines role assignments and estimates parameter values online, with no LLM parameter updates and the transition rules held fixed. Experiments on MARS benchmark show that RoleWorld enables robust generalization across environments with significantly altered object behavior, suggesting that functional role abstractions can serve as an effective component for knowledge transfer in world modeling. 2610.13172.update_target: Role assignments and parameter estimates in a transferred symbolic world model
2610.13172.mechanism_en: A teacher extracts prototypes, fixed rules, and an actor skill; target-world action feedback revises role estimates and triggers hypothesis tests when uncertainty affects decisions.
2610.13172.result_en: MARS experiments report robust transfer despite substantially changed object behavior.
2610.13172.boundary_en: Target transition rules and LLM weights remain fixed; online estimate adaptation should not be described as learning an unconstrained new rule system.
2610.13172.abstract_zh: 世界模型使 LLM 智能体能够预判动作效果并作出知情决策。为实现泛化，世界模型应能高效迁移到交互结构和底层动力学相似的新环境。近期方法把世界动力学编码为符号规则或可执行程序，其组合结构原则上有利于迁移，却仍围绕环境专有对象组织知识。我们提出 RoleWorld，用可复用原型和环境专有参数值构成“功能角色抽象”，表示对象在交互中的行为。教师 LLM 从交互轨迹提取角色原型和定义在角色实例上的可执行转移规则，以及指导行动者利用角色信息决策的技能。在目标世界中，没有教师参与，行动者使用此技能、当前角色分配和参数估计；当不确定性影响当前决策时，主动通过交互测试角色实例假设。每个动作的反馈在线细化角色分配并估计参数值，不更新 LLM 参数，转移规则也保持固定。在 MARS 基准上，RoleWorld 能对对象行为显著变化的环境实现稳健泛化，表明功能角色抽象可以成为世界建模知识迁移的有效组成部分。项目页见原摘要所附链接。

These remain fixed in the target world, where the actor refines role estimates online and tests hypotheses when uncertainty could affect its decision.

2610.13267.title: Forgetting is Not Always Bad: A Neuro-Inspired Memory Repair Mechanism for Poisoned LLM Agents
2610.13267.authors: Lei Liu, Yunji Liang, Xiaowen Zhang, Jingqi Liu, Qi Li, Bin Guo, Zhiwen Yu
2610.13267.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are highly vulnerable to memory-poisoning attacks. Existing defenses primarily rely on external modules for either static memory isolation or continuous online auditing, resulting in low memory efficiency and high computational overhead. To address these limitations, inspired by neuroscientific mechanisms that weak reactivation can destabilize memories and induce decay in the absence of reinforcement, we propose an agent-intrinsic training-free memory repair framework, DREAM (Dynamic Reactivation for Engram Attenuation in Memory), that enables selective functional forgetting of poisoned memories. Specifically, DREAM implements a three-stage pipeline: perturbation-induced implicit reactivation to reveal the structural fragility of malicious memories, adaptive anomaly diagnosis based on multi-dimensional activation patterns to detect topological anomalies, and a dynamic memory repair module that selectively suppresses harmful memories while reinforcing benign ones. Extensive experiments across diverse attackers and real-world tasks demonstrate that DREAM reduces attack success rates by over 95\% against backdoor poisoning while preserving strong benign utility. DREAM also achieves competitive robustness against injection attacks. In terms of runtime and token consumption, DREAM achieves up to a 2.13$\times$ speedup and a 37.7\% reduction in token consumption compared with A-MemGuard. Furthermore, DREAM also achieves a task success rate of 92.96\% on poisoned multi-agent systems.
2610.13267.affiliation: Northwestern Polytechnical University / National University of Singapore
2610.13267.update_target: Functional access to poisoned versus benign memories
2610.13267.mechanism_en: Weak perturbation-driven reactivation exposes anomalies; multi-dimensional diagnosis drives selective suppression of harmful memories and reinforcement of benign ones.
2610.13267.result_en: Backdoor attack success is reduced by over 95%; up to 2.13x speedup and 37.7% fewer tokens versus A-MemGuard, with 92.96% task success on poisoned multi-agent systems.
2610.13267.boundary_en: Memory repair is a bounded adaptation mechanism. Diagnose false suppression and benign utility independently of attack-success reduction.
2610.13267.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体容易受到记忆投毒攻击。现有防御主要依赖外部模块进行静态记忆隔离或持续在线审计，导致记忆效率低、计算开销大。受神经科学中弱再激活可使记忆不稳定并在缺少强化时衰减的机制启发，我们提出智能体内部、无需训练的记忆修复框架 DREAM（记忆痕迹衰减的动态再激活），支持对被投毒记忆进行选择性功能遗忘。DREAM 包含三个阶段：扰动诱导的隐式再激活揭示恶意记忆的结构脆弱性；基于多维激活模式的自适应异常诊断识别拓扑异常；动态记忆修复模块选择性压制有害记忆，同时强化良性记忆。针对不同攻击者和真实任务的广泛实验表明，DREAM 将后门投毒的攻击成功率降低超过 95%，同时保持较强良性效用。对注入攻击也表现出有竞争力的稳健性。在运行时间和 token 消耗上，相比 A-MemGuard，最高加速 2.13 倍、token 消耗降低 37.7%。在被投毒的多智能体系统中，DREAM 的任务成功率还达到 92.96%。
2610.13267.image_caption: Figure 1 : Existing defenses versus neuro-inspired forgetting for poisoned LLM agents. (a) Existing defenses rely on online auditing, which require more computational overhead when continuous scan, or dual-memory isolation, which result in reasoning disruption. (b) Inspired by biological forgetting, weak reactivation destabilizes intrusive memories for gradual decay (left), which motivates weak probing to expose poisoned memories for selective forgetting while preserving benign ones in LLM agents (right).

2610.13345.title: Evo-RL: Iterative Robot Reinforcement Learning from Selective Experience
2610.13345.authors: Kai Ye, Yifan Jin, Qianhang Luo, Hongru Zhang, Jiedong Zhang, Shuyuan Hu, Song-Yuan Wu, Jihai Xu, Jie Zhao, Bo Zhao
2610.13345.abstract_en: Existing real-world reinforcement learning methods improve robot policies by combining human corrections with autonomous rollouts. However, accumulated experience varies in its value for policy improvement, and even successful trajectories can contain inefficient or redundant behavior, motivating more selective experience reuse. To this end, we propose Evo-RL, an iterative reinforcement learning method that combines human interventions with advantage-guided experience selection. Evo-RL uses human corrections and experience with positive estimated advantages from successful trajectories to iteratively refine the policy. To support learning from these different experience sources, we introduce RW-RL-Dataset, which spans over 1,000 hours across four robot embodiments. On a real-world high-precision manipulation task, Evo-RL improves attempt success rate over RECAP by 30.46\%. Our code, model checkpoints, and dataset are publicly available.
2610.13345.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Central South University / South China Normal University / Boden AI
2610.13345.update_target: Robot-policy weights and selectively retained deployment experience
2610.13345.mechanism_en: Deploy the policy, collect autonomous rollouts and human interventions, train value estimates, and select positive-advantage experience for policy refinement and redeployment.
2610.13345.result_en: The dataset exceeds 1,000 hours across four embodiments; attempt success on a real precision-manipulation task improves by 30.46% over RECAP.
2610.13345.boundary_en: Human corrections remain part of the loop. The abstract uses percent rather than explicitly saying percentage points; do not silently change units.
2610.13345.abstract_zh: 现有真实世界强化学习方法结合人类纠正与自主轨迹来改进机器人策略。但积累经验的价值不同，即使成功轨迹也可能包含低效或冗余行为，因此需要更有选择地复用经验。我们提出 Evo-RL，把人类干预与优势引导的经验选择相结合的迭代强化学习方法。Evo-RL 使用人类纠正以及成功轨迹中估计优势为正的经验，反复细化策略。为支持从不同经验来源学习，我们提出 RW-RL-Dataset，覆盖四种机器人形态、超过 1,000 小时。在真实高精度操作任务上，Evo-RL 相比 RECAP 将尝试成功率提高 30.46%。代码、模型检查点和数据集已公开。
2610.13345.image_caption: Fig. 1: Overview of the Evo-RL method. The current policy is deployed to collect demonstrations, human interventions, and autonomous rollouts. Complete trajectories are used to train a value model whose estimates guide policy refinement. The updated policy is then redeployed in the next iteration.

2610.13453.title: Reflect-VLA: Internalizing Reflective Guidance via Dual-Path On-Policy Self-Distillation for Autonomous Driving
2610.13453.authors: Yuechen Luo, He Chong, Fang Li, Shaoqing Xu, Hexin Zhang, Ruiqi Zhang, Ziying Song, Lei Yang, Zhi-Xin Yang, Fuxi Wen
2610.13453.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) substantially improves planning performance in autonomous-driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, existing RL methods rely on scalar trajectory rewards that measure overall quality but fail to identify specific planning errors or provide actionable correction signals. In long-tail scenarios, errors in scene understanding, behavior selection, and trajectory execution are compressed into a single score. We observe that Reflective Guidance turns trajectory evaluation into explicit diagnoses and corrective instructions, substantially improving planning accuracy. Yet such guidance requires an initial prediction and its evaluation results, making it unavailable for direct single-pass inference. We propose Reflect-VLA, which treats Reflective Guidance as training-time privileged information and internalizes its planning benefits through Dual-Path On-Policy Self-Distillation (Dual-OPSD). Unlike scalar-reward optimization, Dual-OPSD uses the driving score only to route student-generated trajectories. It distills dense token-level corrective distributions from the teacher for risky trajectories while applying self-imitation to preserve reliable ones. To provide reliable corrective distributions on student rollouts, the teacher is progressively constructed through Driving-Knowledge Pretraining, Planning-and-Refinement SFT, and Self-Refinement Rejection Sampling. At inference time, Reflect-VLA generates trajectories in a single pass without explicit guidance or iterative refinement. Experiments on NAVSIM v1/v2 and Bench2Drive demonstrate competitive planning performance while reducing training time by over 90% compared with RL.
2610.13453.affiliation: Tsinghua University / University of Macau / USTC / Beijing Jiaotong University / Nanyang Technological University
2610.13453.update_target: Driving-policy weights distilled from reflective corrective distributions
2610.13453.mechanism_en: Route student trajectories by driving score; distill token-level corrections for risky trajectories and self-imitate reliable ones, using a progressively constructed teacher.
2610.13453.result_en: NAVSIM v1/v2 and Bench2Drive evaluations report competitive planning with over 90% less training time than RL.
2610.13453.boundary_en: Reflection is training-time privileged information; inference is single-pass. This is a self-distillation mechanism rather than an online autonomous driving RSI claim.
2610.13453.abstract_zh: 强化学习显著改善自动驾驶视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型的规划表现。但现有 RL 方法依赖度量总体质量的标量轨迹奖励，无法指出具体规划错误或提供可行动纠正信号。在长尾场景中，场景理解、行为选择和轨迹执行错误被压缩成一个分数。我们观察到，反思指导把轨迹评估转化为显式诊断和纠正指令，显著提高规划准确率。但此类指导需要初始预测及其评估结果，无法用于直接单次推理。我们提出 Reflect-VLA，把反思指导视为训练期特权信息，并通过双路径在策略自蒸馏（Dual-OPSD）内化规划收益。不同于标量奖励优化，Dual-OPSD 仅用驾驶得分为学生生成的轨迹分流：对高风险轨迹，蒸馏教师密集的 token 级纠正分布；对可靠轨迹，使用自模仿保留表现。为在学生轨迹上提供可靠纠正分布，教师经过驾驶知识预训练、规划与细化 SFT、自细化拒绝采样逐步构建。推理时，Reflect-VLA 无需显式指导或反复细化，单次生成轨迹。在 NAVSIM v1/v2 和 Bench2Drive 上，它达到有竞争力的规划表现，同时相比 RL 将训练时间减少超过 90%。
2610.13453.image_caption: Figure 1: From Reflective Guidance to Internalized Planning. (a) Reflective Guidance corrects an unsafe initial trajectory during iterative inference, revealing substantial planning gains. (b) Reflect-VLA transfers these gains through Dual-OPSD by aligning teacher and student token distributions along student-generated trajectories. (c) Across different model scales, Reflect-VLA improves planning performance over SFT while requiring substantially less training time than RL, enabling guidance-free single-pass planning.

2610.13485.title: Proactive Agentic Orchestration
2610.13485.authors: Xueyang Feng, Chaozhuo Li, Xiaohe Bo, Jiakai Tang, Chenxi Li, Qiwei Ye, Xu Chen
2610.13485.abstract_en: Agentic orchestration delegates tasks to sub-agents with independent contexts, providing a key path to extending the effective execution horizon of large language model agents. However, existing orchestration methods face two limitations: in execution, current methods fix sub-agents' goals and harnesses at creation time, limiting their adaptability to dynamic real-world environments; in optimization, sparse and delayed feedback constrains effective learning of the orchestration policy. To address these limitations, we introduce POrchestra, an on-the-fly proactive agentic orchestration framework. It allows sub-agents to proactively communicate with the orchestrator at any logical point to request harness adjustments while maintaining continuity of local execution. This mechanism not only enables sub-agents to adapt seamlessly to dynamic environments but also naturally inspires On-Policy Orchestration Distillation (OPOD) based on hindsight feedback. OPOD attributes sub-agents' proactive revision requests back to preceding orchestration decisions to derive targeted improvement signals, and leverages these signals as process supervision alongside the final reward to optimize the orchestration policy. We evaluate POrchestra on three long-horizon agent benchmarks spanning deep research, dynamic digital assistance, and software engineering. POrchestra improves task success by an average of 9.1% relative to the strongest baseline; combined with OPOD, it improves small-orchestrator success by an average of 10.0% relative to existing training baselines. POrchestra also achieves a more favorable cost-performance trade-off. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .
2610.13485.affiliation: Renmin University of China / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
2610.13485.update_target: Subagent harness adjustments and orchestration-policy weights
2610.13485.mechanism_en: Proactive revision requests change running subagent harnesses. Hindsight attribution assigns those requests to earlier orchestration decisions for OPOD process supervision.
2610.13485.result_en: Average task success gains are 9.1% versus the strongest baseline; OPOD improves small-orchestrator success by 10.0% over training baselines.
2610.13485.boundary_en: Separate runtime harness adaptation from learned orchestration improvements. Account for communication and hindsight-supervision costs.
2610.13485.abstract_zh: 智能体编排把任务分配给具有独立上下文的子智能体，是延长大语言模型有效执行周期的重要路径。但现有方法有两点限制：执行阶段在创建子智能体时固定其目标和运行框架，限制对动态现实环境的适应；优化阶段稀疏、延迟反馈限制编排策略的有效学习。我们提出 POrchestra，一个即时主动智能体编排框架，允许子智能体在任意逻辑时点主动与编排器通信，请求调整框架，同时保持局部执行连续性。这既使子智能体能无缝适应动态环境，也自然启发基于事后反馈的在策略编排蒸馏（OPOD）。OPOD 把子智能体的主动修订请求归因到此前编排决策，产生针对性改进信号，并将其作为过程监督与最终奖励一起优化编排策略。我们在涵盖深度研究、动态数字助理和软件工程的三个长周期基准上评估。POrchestra 相比最强基线平均提高任务成功率 9.1%；结合 OPOD，相比现有训练基线平均提高小型编排器成功率 10.0%。它也取得更有利的成本—性能权衡。代码已通过原摘要所附链接公开。
2610.13485.image_caption: Figure 1: Comparison of orchestration paradigms. (a) Offline orchestration fixes harnesses and workflows. (b) Re-orchestration adapts harnesses upon completion or predefined triggers. (c) POrchestra integrates execution and harness adaptation via proactive sub-agent communication.

2610.13816.title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
2610.13816.authors: Bahey Tharwat, Iman Nematollahi, Marvin Alles, Xingyuan Zhang, Akshay L Chandra, Abhinav Valada
2610.13816.categories_text: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.13816.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $\pi_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $\pi_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.
2610.13816.affiliation: University of Freiburg / Technical University of Munich
2610.13816.update_target: A steering module over a frozen generalist robot policy
2610.13816.mechanism_en: A frozen world model rehearses earlier tasks through imagined rollouts while the module learns new tasks; learn in imagination only when model fidelity suffices.
2610.13816.result_en: Eight CALVIN tasks improve 63.7% → 74.8%, whereas sequential LoRA drops to 11.7%; three real Franka tasks improve in imagination with retention.
2610.13816.boundary_en: The world model and generalist policy stay fixed. Model fidelity determines whether imagination supports new-task learning or only rehearsal.
2610.13816.abstract_zh: 通用机器人策略通过模仿学习训练，受演示质量和覆盖范围限制。强化学习可以通过微调策略权重，或训练小模块控制冻结生成策略的输入噪声，改善并扩展能力。但任务顺序到来时，两种方法都会灾难性遗忘：在某任务上微调会降低旧任务表现，而引导方法只把遗忘转移到共享引导模块。我们提出 Dream to Remember（D2R），持续引导冻结通用策略学习新任务，同时保留旧技能。当引导模块学习新任务时，冻结预训练世界模型通过想象轨迹排练旧任务，在无需重放缓冲区或新数据的情况下，将模块锚定到先前行为。世界模型足够忠实时，新任务可以完全在想象中学习；否则，在环境中学习新任务，而世界模型仅用于旧任务排练。在 CALVIN 上，D2R 完全通过想象顺序改进八个任务，将平均成功率从 63.7% 提高到 74.8%；相同序列上的 LoRA 微调将其降至 11.7%。使用冻结现成通用策略 π₀ 和世界模型 A2World，D2R 在环境中学习未见 LIBERO-90 任务，同时保持 π₀ 在其微调过的 LIBERO 套件上的表现，尽管世界模型精度不足以支持策略优化。最后，在真实 Franka 机器人上，D2R 完全在想象中顺序改进三个任务，并保留此前改进。

2610.13494.title: Humanize MLE Agents: Multi-Agent Session Alternation Beyond Single-Agent Limits
2610.13494.authors: Changye Li, Zijian Zhang, Muheng Li, Yiduo Pang, Tingjun Wu, Menghan Li, Yitong Liu, Hongkai Guo, Mengchi Chen, Chenyu He, Kaisheng Ma, Wei Xu, Song Han, Sihao Liu, Ligeng Zhu
2610.13494.abstract_en: Existing LLM-based agent approaches for long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) often use context engineering, implemented through custom harnesses that manage tools, skills, and accumulated experience. However, we find that as single-session execution lengthens, the agent's reasoning intensity declines alongside slowing progress, summarized as long-horizon deceleration, and the benefits of these custom harnesses vanish as the underlying model improves, summarized as harness staleness. These findings suggest that their benefits may not persist across versions, which motivates a workflow-level approach in which agents build on one another's work across sessions. We model these alternating agent sessions as a context-reset semi-Markov decision process (CR-SMDP) and establish sufficient conditions for alternation to exceed single-agent reference limits, derive an explicit experiment-budget bound, and characterize when session caps preserve this advantage. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Humanize MLE Agents (HMA), which alternates two agents on a shared workspace, limits each session to at most k experiments and resets the context between sessions, without additional task-specific harness or prior knowledge supplements. Across 75 Kaggle tasks in MLE-bench, HMA reaches a state-of-the-art any-medal rate of 78.2%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 8.0 points with a quarter of its time budget. Moreover, among six configurations spanning five heterogeneous agent pairs, HMA improves any-medal rate over the constituent baselines by 6.4 points on average, demonstrating cross-pair generality. A supplementary case on kernel optimization reaches 878 cycles, within 1.6% of the community leaderboard leader, demonstrating applicability beyond MLE.
2610.13494.affiliation: Tsinghua University / NVIDIA / Zhejiang University / MIT
2610.13494.update_target: Retained experimental artifacts across alternating MLE sessions
2610.13494.mechanism_en: Two agents alternate on a shared workspace, cap experiments per session, and reset context while building on prior candidates; a CR-SMDP analysis gives conditional budget guarantees.
2610.13494.result_en: Across 75 Kaggle tasks, any-medal rate is 78.2%, +8.0 points over the strongest open baseline with one-quarter its time budget.
2610.13494.boundary_en: This is workflow-level experience reuse, not self-modification of model weights. Theoretical sufficient conditions do not certify every task or agent pair.
2610.13494.abstract_zh: 现有长周期机器学习工程智能体通常通过定制运行框架进行上下文工程，管理工具、技能和积累经验。但我们发现，单会话执行越长，推理强度和进展速度一起下降，即长周期减速；随着底层模型改善，定制框架收益可能消失，即框架过时。这说明收益未必跨版本持续，促使我们采用工作流层方法，让不同会话的智能体接续彼此工作。我们用上下文重置半马尔可夫决策过程（CR-SMDP）建模交替会话，给出交替超越单智能体参考极限的充分条件，推导显式实验预算界，并刻画何种会话上限能保留优势。据此，我们提出 Humanize MLE Agents（HMA）：两个智能体在共享工作区轮流执行，每会话最多 k 次实验，会话间重置上下文，无需额外任务专用框架或先验知识补充。在 MLE-bench 的 75 个 Kaggle 任务上，HMA 取得当前最优的 78.2% 任意奖牌率，比最强开源基线高 8.0 点，使用其四分之一时间预算。六种配置覆盖五对异构智能体，平均比各组成基线高 6.4 点，展示跨组合泛化。补充的核优化案例达到 878 周期，距社区榜首在 1.6% 以内，展示超出 MLE 的适用性。
2610.13494.image_caption: Figure 1: HMA overview. (A) Declining output tokens per response accompany diminishing score gains, indicating decelerating single-agent exploration; harness gains can vanish or reverse as models improve. (B) HMA alternates native agents after at most k k experiments, resetting context while preserving shared work and candidates for final review. The motor analogy illustrates options A A and B B alternately energizing shared state X i X_{i} toward the final result E ^ \widehat{E} . The CR-SMDP view captures how complementary options can extend exploration beyond single-agent limits.

2610.13632.title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
2610.13632.authors: Zhengyang Zhang, Jing Xiong, Hongzhou Lin, Juihui Chung, Zijian Zhang, Song Han, Sihao Liu, Ligeng Zhu
2610.13632.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erdős Conjectures database. Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: early errors can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and apparent success can mask a misinterpretation or weakening of the original task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent), an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer evaluates each candidate and provides actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model pretraining. Third, a verifier checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA achieves perfect scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026, near-full marks on the IChO 2026 problem set, and solves all 672 problems (100%) on PutnamBench. On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks first, solving 251 of 304 problems (82.6%). We further evaluate HOA with open models. Using Kimi-K3, HOA achieves full scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI, and a gold-level score of 97.1% on the IChO. These results closely match the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline on the IMO and IPhO, while exceeding it on the IChO and IOI, demonstrating that systematic feedback can help bridge substantial differences in base-model capability.
2610.13632.affiliation: Tsinghua University / NVIDIA / University of Hong Kong / MIT / Princeton University / Amazon
2610.13632.update_target: Candidate solutions, task-specific wiki knowledge, and multi-session review
2610.13632.mechanism_en: Independent review, a structured wiki, and checking Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements guide subsequent problem-solving sessions.
2610.13632.result_en: GPT-5.6 Sol resolves all 672 PutnamBench problems; Lean-Eval is 251/304 (82.6%), with additional olympiad and open-model evaluations.
2610.13632.boundary_en: Candidate improvement and trusted-statement verification are task-bound. The introductory claims about other systems are context, not findings independently certified here.
2610.13632.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体在长周期科学和奥林匹克竞赛任务上迅速进步。近期系统生成了 Navier–Stokes 问题的 Lean 形式化解答，并自主解决 Erdős 猜想数据库中的四个开放问题，但都没有同时发布底层模型与完整推理栈。更普遍地，单次智能体会话在困难问题上仍很脆弱：早期错误会传播，缺少领域知识会停滞，表面成功可能掩盖对原任务的误解或弱化。我们提出 HOA（Humanize Olympiads Agent），通过三条互补反馈渠道协调多个智能体会话的开放工作流框架。第一，独立审阅者评估每个候选并提供可行动反馈；第二，结构化 wiki 提供模型预训练中可能缺失或不可靠的任务专用知识；第三，验证器依据可信挑战命题检查生成的 Lean 证明。使用 GPT-5.6 Sol，HOA 在 IMO、IPhO、IOI 2026 上取得满分，IChO 2026 接近满分，并解决 PutnamBench 全部 672 题（100%）。在 Lean-Eval 排行榜上，它以解决 304 题中的 251 题（82.6%）排名第一。我们也评估开放模型：使用 Kimi-K3 时，在 IMO、IPhO、IOI 上满分，IChO 达到金牌水平的 97.1%。这些结果在 IMO 和 IPhO 上接近闭源 GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal 基线，并在 IChO 和 IOI 上超过它，说明系统反馈有助于弥合基础模型之间的显著能力差异。
2610.13632.image_caption: Figure 1: HOA replaces a brittle one-shot workflow with iterative review, knowledge retrieval, and verification. The bottom row summarizes results from high-school olympiads to research-level formal mathematics.

2610.13386.title: MoPrO-SD: Modular Prompt Optimization for Stance Detection
2610.13386.authors: Meysam Sabbaghan, Nikesh Gyawali, Arman Zareian Jahromi, Sebastian Loera-Lozano, Doina Caragea, Cornelia Caragea
2610.13386.abstract_en: Stance detection remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) due to implicit opinions, sarcasm, and context-dependent expressions of stance. Although automatic prompt optimization offers an alternative to fine-tuning without updating model parameters, existing structured approaches are not specifically designed around stance-label semantics and class-specific ambiguities. We introduce MoPrO-SD, a stance-specific prompt optimization framework that decomposes prompts into functional semantic modules and refines them sequentially using LLM-based feedback. We study three refinement strategies: instruction-only optimization (I), instruction with reasoning (I+R), and instruction with per-example reasoning (I+R+E), using class-conditioned errors for stance-label refinement. We also introduce VaccineStance, a new human-annotated benchmark for vaccine stance detection. Experiments across four datasets and five open-weight LLMs show that MoPrO-SD improves upon the human-written Base prompt in many settings. On SemEval-2016, class-conditioned feedback achieves higher mean Macro-F1 than pooled feedback for four of five backbones. Both reasoning-based strategies, I+R and I+R+E, achieve strong performance, with their relative effectiveness varying across models and datasets, while remaining competitive with recent prompt optimization methods. The MoPrO-SD code and VaccineStance dataset are available on GitHub.
2610.13386.affiliation: Kansas State University / University of Illinois Chicago
2610.13386.mechanism_en: Sequential LLM-guided revisions use class-conditioned errors; validation Macro-F1 selects prompts for final testing across instruction and reasoning variants.
2610.13386.result_en: Four datasets and five open LLMs are evaluated; class-conditioned feedback improves mean Macro-F1 over pooled feedback for four of five SemEval backbones.
2610.13386.boundary_en: Task-specific prompt refinement is an external optimization mechanism; keep validation selection and final test results distinct.
2610.13386.abstract_zh: 对大语言模型而言，隐含观点、讽刺和依赖上下文的立场表达，使立场检测仍具有挑战。自动提示优化提供了不更新模型参数的微调替代方案，但现有结构化方法并未针对立场标签语义和类别专有歧义设计。我们提出 MoPrO-SD，一个立场专用提示优化框架，把提示拆成功能语义模块，并使用 LLM 反馈逐模块细化。研究三种策略：仅指令优化（I）、指令加推理（I+R）、指令加逐样本推理（I+R+E），使用按类别区分的错误细化立场标签。我们还提出 VaccineStance，一个用于疫苗立场检测的人工标注基准。在四个数据集和五个开放权重 LLM 上，MoPrO-SD 在许多设置下优于人工 Base 提示。在 SemEval-2016 上，按类别反馈对五个主干中的四个取得比汇总反馈更高的平均 Macro-F1。两种推理策略 I+R 和 I+R+E 均表现较强，相对效果因模型与数据集而异，同时能与近期提示优化方法竞争。MoPrO-SD 代码和 VaccineStance 数据集可在 GitHub 获取。
2610.13386.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of MoPrO-SD. Starting from a six-module base prompt, MoPrO-SD sequentially refines the modules using instruction-only (I), instruction with reasoning (I+R), or instruction with per-example reasoning (I+R+E). After each iteration, the updated prompt is evaluated using validation Macro-F1, and the highest-scoring prompt is selected for final test evaluation.

2610.13663.title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
2610.13663.authors: Ivan Moloshnikov, Dmitry Kunitsyn, Alexander Sboev, Maksim Skorokhodov, Roman Rybka, Yuanchao Liu
2610.13663.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)
2610.13663.abstract_en: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks---spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equations---the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.
2610.13663.affiliation: Kurchatov Institute / National Research Nuclear University MEPhI / Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology / Harbin Institute of Technology
2610.13663.update_target: Specified functional blocks of fixed-architecture neural networks
2610.13663.mechanism_en: Analyst, coder, and recorder generate component code, evaluate it in a sandbox, and retain experiment logs to guide subsequent candidates.
2610.13663.result_en: Five SNN/PINN tasks show +13/+6 percentage-point classification gains and large task-specific physical-error reductions.
2610.13663.boundary_en: The network structure and optimizer framework remain fixed. Selected-run 2491x/325x error reductions should not be generalized to every initialization or task.
2610.13663.abstract_zh: 许多机器学习方法分为两层：专家选择方法类别，而类别内关键组件的选择至关重要，通常由人工完成。本文研究这些组件的自动调优，提出可迁移到不同性质模型的框架。这个多智能体 LLM 框架有分析者、编码者和记录者三个角色，配备实验日志和沙箱执行环境。不同于优化整个 ML 脚本或在离散空间搜索架构的系统，它在开放但语义范围狭窄的空间中工作：智能体只生成指定组件的代码，保持整体网络结构不变。我们从两个方向验证：调优采用相关学习的分类脉冲神经网络，以及用物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解高阶微分方程。五项任务包括 MNIST 与 Digits 脉冲分类，以及广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）和 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky（KS）方程的边值问题。智能体优于基线：MNIST 和 Digits 分类准确率分别高 13 和 6 个百分点；相对解析单孤子解的误差约降低 2491 倍；选定的带高斯扰动 GNLSE 运行中不变量保持误差降低约 325 倍，在重复初始化中平均降低超过 100 倍；带高斯扰动的 KS 问题中质量漂移降低 14 倍。因此，该框架无需改变内部结构，就能在不同性质任务上调优关键组件。

2610.12569.title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
2610.12569.authors: Wei Minn, Zhensu Sun, Lwin Khin Shar, David Lo
2610.12569.abstract_en: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each turn, the Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions. It proposes and implements a new feature with feature tests, then embeds a subtle bug in that feature along with sealed bug-triggering tests. The resulting pull request is admitted only if (1) it passes the feature tests and the repository's existing tests while failing exactly the bug tests, and (2) a fresh session of the same agent can repair the bug blind, which rules out unsolvable tasks. The Blue agent then reviews the pull request without being told a bug exists. It wins only if its revision passes all three test suites, and then the two agents swap roles. We run a tournament among 11 model-harness participants on 15 repositories in five languages for 1,500 turns. The leaders win in different ways. GPT-5.5 with Codex CLI ranks first as the strongest solver, repairing 98.3% of the defects it reviews. Claude Opus 4.8 with mini-swe-agent ranks second as the strongest task author, with a 27.3% Red win rate. Finally, within one model family, tasks written by the newest version defeat a fixed-reference solver far more often than those of older versions (42.9% vs. 4.0%), giving preliminary evidence that task difficulty scales with task authoring capability.
2610.12569.update_target: Dynamically authored coding tasks and executable acceptance oracles
2610.12569.mechanism_en: Mirrored Red–Blue turns require feature preservation, exactly targeted bug-test failure, and a fresh blind repair check before admission; participants then swap roles.
2610.12569.result_en: A 1,500-turn tournament covers 11 participants and 15 repositories; GPT-5.5/Codex repairs 98.3% of reviewed defects.
2610.12569.boundary_en: Arena difficulty can scale with task authors, but evaluation-time generation does not itself train or recursively improve participant agents.
2610.12569.abstract_zh: 静态代码基准在发布时就固定，任务逐渐泄漏到训练数据，更强智能体最终使其饱和。我们认为基准应当自扩展：任务和判定标准在评估时生成，没有预先存在的内容可供泄漏，难度由参与智能体决定而非发布时固定。我们提出 SWE-Duel，两个编码智能体通过镜像红蓝回合互相评估的竞技场。每回合，红方在真实仓库中经历三个上下文隔离会话：提出并实现新功能与功能测试，再在功能中嵌入细微缺陷和密封的缺陷触发测试。只有满足两条条件，PR 才获准进入竞技场：一是通过功能测试与仓库原有测试，并恰好仅在缺陷测试上失败；二是同一智能体的新会话能够盲修该缺陷，以排除无解任务。蓝方不知道存在缺陷，审查 PR，只有修订通过全部三套测试才获胜，随后交换角色。我们让 11 个模型—框架参与者在五种语言的 15 个仓库上比赛 1,500 回合。领先者以不同方式获胜：GPT-5.5 配 Codex CLI 是最强求解者，修复所审查缺陷的 98.3%，排名第一；Claude Opus 4.8 配 mini-swe-agent 是最强任务作者，红方胜率 27.3%，排名第二。在同一模型家族内，最新版本编写的任务击败固定参考求解者的频率显著高于旧版本（42.9% 对 4.0%），为任务难度随出题能力扩展提供初步证据。

2610.12601.title: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting
2610.12601.authors: Elias Lumer, Sahil Sen, Vamse Kumar Subbiah, Kevin Paul
2610.12601.abstract_en: Prompt optimization is an attractive alternative to reinforcement learning for adapting language-model agents, since it is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts. On factual tasks, however, it carries a failure mode that scalar-reward reinforcement learning does not. An optimizer that reads the training examples can write their answers into the prompt, so an in-distribution gain may be memorization rather than transferable behaviour. We apply reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to the two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent and evaluate it under a topic-disjoint split in which no topic is shared across train, validation, and test. Held-out citation reward rises by 0.079, from 0.702 to 0.781, with a bootstrap 95\% confidence interval of [0.051, 0.107], and the gain replicates across three seeds (mean 0.107). Nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, yet a controlled ablation shows this content earns no reward even on the exact training questions it encodes. The large validation-minus-held-out gap is therefore small-sample selection under a noisy judge, not memorization. Varying the verifier isolates what makes the gain transfer. Decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient, and collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative. The gain persists under an out-of-family judge and is largely reproduced by a hand-written version of the discovered recipe. Credible evaluation of prompt optimizers therefore requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablations. We release the candidate prompts, lineage diffs, figures, tables, and analysis.
2610.12601.update_target: Evaluation of evolved deep-research prompts and verifier feedback
2610.12601.mechanism_en: Topic-disjoint splits, three seeds, answer-key ablations, decomposed-versus-scalar feedback, and out-of-family judges test transfer and prompt overfitting.
2610.12601.result_en: Held-out reward rises 0.702 → 0.781, gain 0.079 with 95% interval [0.051, 0.107]; decomposed feedback is necessary for positive transfer in the tested ablation.
2610.12601.boundary_en: Nearly half the winning prompt is an answer key, yet its content earns no reward on encoded questions. The reported gap is attributed to noisy small-sample selection, not memorization.
2610.12601.abstract_zh: 提示优化是替代强化学习、适配语言模型智能体的有吸引力选择，成本低且产生人类可读产物。但在事实性任务中，它存在标量奖励强化学习没有的失败模式：能够读取训练样本的优化器可能把答案写入提示，分布内收益可能来自记忆而非可迁移行为。我们对多智能体深度研究智能体的两个系统提示应用反思提示演化（GEPA），并采用训练、验证、测试之间无共享主题的划分评估。留出引用奖励提高 0.079，从 0.702 到 0.781，bootstrap 95% 置信区间为 [0.051, 0.107]；三个种子复现收益，均值为 0.107。获胜提示近一半是记忆的答案键，但受控消融显示，即使在它编码的原始训练问题上，这些内容也没有获得奖励。因此，大的验证与留出差距来自噪声评委下的小样本选择，而非记忆。改变验证器能分离迁移收益的成因：按维度分解反馈是关键因果因素，压缩成单一标量奖励会使留出迁移变负。收益在家族外评委下仍成立，且用人工编写的已发现策略版本大体能复现。因此，可信提示优化评估需要留出主题、多种子和验证器消融。我们发布候选提示、谱系差异、配图、表格和分析。

2610.12822.title: Reward Hacking as a Transmissible Strategy in Multi-Agent Coding Systems
2610.12822.authors: Yuepeng Hu, Pegah Ghahremani, Reza Aghajani, Mahesh Pasupuleti, Himaghna Bhattacharjee
2610.12822.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.12822.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used to solve coding tasks by coordinating agents that share code and plans. These agents are often optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) using automated evaluators, but bypassing evaluation can earn reward without producing a genuine solution. Prior work has largely treated reward hacking as a single-agent failure. In this work, we show that a reward-hacking strategy elicited in one agent can propagate to others and affect system coordination. Across four open-weight backbones, coding RL elicits and amplifies reward hacking in two settings: explicit mechanism descriptions in the system prompt and mid-training that models upstream exposure to facts about the coding environment. Using post-RL agents from the mid-training setting as sources, we observe propagation through code and shared memory, and across roles through natural-language plans. Even agents based on small open-weight models induce reward hacking in stronger closed-weight targets. On hard tasks, propagation can intensify along a transmission chain after the original source leaves as the code acquires more persuasive justifications. We also theoretically analyze conditions under which reward hacking amplifies, persists, or decays across agent interactions. Beyond propagation, reward hacking can bias task routing toward reward-hacking agents and survive candidate aggregation. As potential mitigations, we evaluate code review by the coder or a separate verifier, both of which reduce delivered hacks. Together, these results establish reward hacking as a transmissible strategy whose effects extend beyond the agent in which it first emerges.
2610.12822.update_target: Reward-hacking strategies transmitted across coding agents
2610.12822.mechanism_en: Coding RL forms source strategies; code, shared memory, and plans transmit them across agents and roles. Theory analyzes amplification, persistence, and decay; review is tested as mitigation.
2610.12822.result_en: Across four open backbones, even small-model sources induce hacks in stronger closed targets; routing and aggregation can preserve or favor the strategy.
2610.12822.boundary_en: More reward or stronger coordination can reflect transmitted evaluator bypass, not genuine solution quality. Review mitigations are evaluated rather than universal guarantees.
2610.12822.abstract_zh: 多智能体系统越来越多地通过共享代码和计划的协作智能体完成编码任务。这些智能体通常用自动评估器进行强化学习，但绕过评估可以在没有真实解答时获得奖励。此前研究主要把奖励利用视为单智能体失败。本文表明，在一个智能体中诱导出的奖励利用策略会传播到其他智能体，并影响系统协作。在四个开放权重主干上，编码 RL 在两种设置中诱导并放大奖励利用：系统提示明确描述利用机制，以及模拟上游接触编码环境事实的中期训练。使用后一设置的 RL 后智能体作为来源，我们观察到策略通过代码和共享记忆传播，也通过自然语言计划跨角色传播。即使基于小型开放权重模型的智能体，也能在更强闭源目标中诱导奖励利用。在困难任务中，代码获得更具说服力的理由后，原来源离开以后，传播链仍可能强化利用。我们还理论分析利用在智能体交互中放大、持续或衰减的条件。除传播外，奖励利用会把任务路由偏向利用型智能体，并在候选聚合后保留下来。作为可能缓解方法，我们评估由编码者或独立验证器进行代码审查，两者都减少交付的利用代码。结果把奖励利用确立为一种可传播策略，其影响超出最初出现的智能体。

2610.12855.title: Mitigating Capability Degradation in LLM Self-Improvement via Representation Geometry Regularization
2610.12855.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-distillation is a self-improvement paradigm that enables large language models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities by leveraging the same model as both teacher and student under different conditioning contexts. However, we find that OPSD methods can progressively degrade previously acquired capabilities: queries that are correctly responded at earlier training stages may become incorrectly responded as optimization proceeds, even the overall performance continues to improve. Further analysis reveals that this degradation coincides with a deterioration of the geometry of hidden representations, characterized by reduced intra-cluster compactness and diminished inter-cluster separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR), which preserves representation geometry during post-training by encouraging compactness within cluster and separation across cluster. RGR can be seamlessly integrated into existing OPSD methods without altering their core optimization procedures. Extensive experiments on multiple OPSD methods and benchmarks show that RGR generally alleviates capability degradation while retaining capability improvements. Our code is available in this https URL .
2610.12855.mechanism_en: Track previously correct queries and representation geometry; RGR preserves within-cluster compactness and between-cluster separation while retaining the underlying OPSD procedure.
2610.12855.result_en: Multiple OPSD methods and benchmarks show reduced capability degradation while maintaining gains.
2610.12855.boundary_en: Overall average improvement can hide per-query forgetting. Correlated geometry changes and a tested regularizer do not establish a universal causal explanation.
2610.12855.abstract_zh: 在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）是一种自改进范式，使 LLM 在不同条件上下文下用同一模型同时作为教师和学生，从而改善能力。但我们发现，OPSD 可能逐渐损害先前获得的能力：训练早期正确回答的问题，随着优化推进可能变错，即使整体表现继续提升。进一步分析表明，这种下降伴随隐藏表示几何结构恶化，包括簇内紧凑性降低和簇间分离减弱。受此观察启发，我们提出表示几何正则化（RGR），在后训练中鼓励簇内紧凑和簇间分离，以保留表示几何。RGR 可以无缝加入现有 OPSD 方法，不改变核心优化过程。多种 OPSD 方法和基准上的广泛实验表明，RGR 通常减轻能力下降，同时保留能力提升。代码可通过原摘要所附链接获取。

2610.13021.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
2610.13021.authors: Jie Huang, Yanan Chen, Ruixun Liu, Kaichen He, Xinyi He, Rui Huang, Zilong Zheng, Zhenliang Zhang, Yiwu Zhong
2610.13021.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.13021.abstract_en: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at this https URL .
2610.13021.affiliation: Peking University / BIGAI / University of Hong Kong
2610.13021.update_target: Compositional transfer from basic-task experience to unseen embodied tasks
2610.13021.mechanism_en: Simulation compares harnesses and learning methods on learning basic skills and recombining them for advanced tasks.
2610.13021.result_en: Basic experience gives stable gains even as tasks become more complex, but improvements do not scale with more learning samples.
2610.13021.boundary_en: This is a benchmark and reported learning limitation, not an achieved RSI system. Sample quantity and meaningful transferable information should be measured separately.
2610.13021.abstract_zh: 持续学习要求模型积累经验并迁移到新任务。尽管持续学习已有大量研究，现有工作主要局限于非具身设置，尚未充分扩展到具身环境。为此，我们提出 EmbodiedCLBench，首个在具身仿真中评估自进化智能体持续学习能力的基准。以组合泛化为核心原则，评估智能体能否先从基本任务学习，再组合已获得技能解决复杂、未见的高级任务。我们比较多种运行框架和学习方法，发现一致局限及不同表现。高级任务在零样本设置中很难解决，基本任务经验却能带来持续改进，且任务复杂性提高时收益仍稳定。但改进并不随学习样本数量相应扩展，当前智能体无法从额外经验中提取有意义信息。结果突出持续学习作为具身智能体基础却研究不足的能力；基准为设计有效自进化智能体提供资源。代码与数据可通过原摘要所附链接获取。

2610.13227.title: Understanding and Mitigating Cross-Session Attacks via Persistent Artifacts in Agent Skill Composition
2610.13227.authors: Dianshu Liao, Shidong Pan, Guangdong Bai, Zhenchang Xing, Xiaoyu Sun
2610.13227.abstract_en: Agent skills extend the capabilities of AI agents by bundling instructions, code, and resources into reusable packages. During skill execution, agents may produce or modify artifacts, such as files, configurations, and cached data, that are reused by other skills in later sessions. Since these artifacts can persist across sessions and later be accessed by other skills, they introduce a new attack surface that can be exploited to influence subsequent executions. However, the security risks arising from such cross-session skill interactions remain largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate cross-session composition attacks in skill-based AI agents and develop a runtime defense against them. Specifically, we characterize three attack mechanisms, namely Instruction Propagation (IP), Data Boundary Violation (DBV), and Evidence Poisoning (EP), through which malicious effects propagate across skill executions via persistent artifacts. To evaluate whether existing agents can resist these attacks while completing legitimate tasks, we construct SkillRelayBench, a benchmark of 270 adversarial cases drawn from 30 cross-session skill-composition scenarios across ten domains. Our evaluation of seven models across Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Claude Code reveals attack success rates (ASR) ranging from 46.7% to 77.4% and attack chain success rates (ACSR) ranging from 35.6% to 61.1%. Successful attack chains cover all five target security consequence categories, highlighting the broad impact of these attacks. To mitigate these risks, we propose SkillRelayGuard, which restores artifact provenance context and provides pre-execution advisory review while leaving the final execution decision to the agent. Evaluation across three agent settings shows that SkillRelayGuard reduces overall ASR from 69.5% to 10.9% and ACSR from 54.8% to 10.0%, while increasing legitimate task completion from 79.6% to 87.5%.

2610.13227.update_target: Security of persistent artifacts reused across skill sessions
2610.13227.mechanism_en: SkillRelayBench isolates instruction propagation, data-boundary violations, and evidence poisoning; provenance restoration and pre-execution advisory review are evaluated.
2610.13227.result_en: Across three agent settings, SkillRelayGuard lowers ASR 69.5% → 10.9% and attack-chain success 54.8% → 10.0%, while legitimate completion rises 79.6% → 87.5%.
2610.13227.boundary_en: Persistent reuse can carry malicious instructions as well as useful experience. Advisory review leaves the final decision to the agent; tested attacks bound effectiveness.
2610.13227.abstract_zh: 智能体技能通过封装指令、代码和资源，扩展 AI 智能体能力。执行技能时，智能体可能生成或修改文件、配置和缓存数据等产物，供后续会话的其他技能复用。这些跨会话持久产物带来可影响后续执行的新攻击面，但其安全风险仍缺少研究。我们调查基于技能的 AI 智能体中的跨会话组合攻击，并提出运行时防御。具体刻画三种机制：指令传播（IP）、数据边界违反（DBV）和证据投毒（EP），恶意效果通过持久产物跨技能传播。为评估现有智能体能否抵抗攻击并完成合法任务，我们构建 SkillRelayBench，包含十个领域、30 个跨会话技能组合场景的 270 个对抗案例。对 Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Claude Code 中七个模型的评估，攻击成功率（ASR）为 46.7%–77.4%，攻击链成功率（ACSR）为 35.6%–61.1%。成功攻击链覆盖全部五种目标安全后果，展示广泛影响。我们提出 SkillRelayGuard，恢复产物来源上下文，并在执行前提供建议性审查，最终决定仍由智能体作出。在三种智能体设置中，它把整体 ASR 从 69.5% 降至 10.9%，ACSR 从 54.8% 降至 10.0%，并把合法任务完成率从 79.6% 提高到 87.5%。

2610.13361.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
2610.13361.authors: Jiahao Wang, Hongjin Qian, Yuyang Hu, Jiajun Zhang, Zheng Liu
2610.13361.categories_text: Software Engineering (cs.SE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.13361.abstract_en: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creation of a complete agent from a natural-language requirement, Editing of production agent codebases, and Optimization toward a measurable target. Each of its 25 tasks is framed as a commission rather than an exam: the builder iterates against a handful of illustrative cases, while acceptance exercises the frozen submission on held-out cases designed to span the full requirement, grading behavior against requirement-derived rubrics under hard pass/fail gates or, for Optimization, against the source benchmark's own objective. Evaluating a range of coding agents across models and harnesses, we find that none comes close to delivering what a requirement asks for: the gap between what a builder demonstrates and what it delivers is the norm, not the corner case. An accompanying empirical analysis of the failure trajectories identifies recurring failure modes, among them overfitting to the visible cases, hollow runtimes behind code that looks complete, and unsupported claims of completion, each a signal by which coding agents can learn to build the agents they are asked for.
2610.13361.affiliation: Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence / Institute of Automation, CAS / Renmin University of China
2610.13361.update_target: Held-out behavioral acceptance of agents built or optimized by coding agents
2610.13361.mechanism_en: Twenty-five commissions cover creation, editing, and optimization. Frozen deliveries face requirement-derived rubrics and hard gates beyond visible development examples.
2610.13361.result_en: No evaluated builder comes close to fully meeting requirements; failures include visible-case overfitting, hollow runtimes, and unsupported completion claims.
2610.13361.boundary_en: A convincing demonstration or improved development score is not evidence that the delivered agent meets held-out requirements.
2610.13361.abstract_zh: 软件生产逐渐交给软件本身，编码智能体也越来越多地受委托构建适配用户工作流的智能体。这种委托隐含假定：交付智能体会忠实服务其需求，而不只是看起来如此。现有基准没有检验这一假定。我们提出 AgentSWE，覆盖智能体开发生命周期三阶段：根据自然语言需求创建完整智能体，编辑生产智能体代码库，以及针对可测目标优化。25 个任务都作为委托而非考试：构建者围绕少量示例反复开发，验收在留出案例上运行冻结提交，覆盖完整需求，依据需求导出的准则和硬通过/失败门槛评分；优化阶段则使用源基准自身目标。评估不同模型和运行框架的编码智能体后发现，没有一种接近完整满足需求：构建者演示与真实交付之间的差距是常态而非边缘情况。失败轨迹分析识别出可见案例过拟合、看似完整代码背后的空壳运行系统，以及无依据的完成声明等反复出现的失败模式，它们都可以成为编码智能体学习如何构建所需智能体的信号。

2610.13829.title: MC-EvoBench: Auditing Experience-Driven Self-Improvement in Minecraft Agents
2610.13829.authors: Jingwei Song, Zhisheng Chen, Bingfan Zeng, Jing Tang, Yubo Hou, Jinhao Jing, Zhengwei Xie, Linfeng Zhang
2610.13829.abstract_en: A central challenge in embodied recursive self-improvement is enabling agents to convert interaction history into capabilities that persist beyond one world and transfer to later tasks. A saved memory or successful final action does not by itself establish that a reusable capability was acquired; evaluation must separate capability change from carried-over resources, unequal source exposure, and early execution failures. We construct MC-EvoBench as a controlled Minecraft benchmark with a fixed catalog of 19 registered evolution chains, including 12 primary evaluation chains and seven calibration or probe chains, together with three graph-aligned paired probe families for transfer. The benchmark represents each task as a task-state graph, defines stage-level environment verifiers, assigns matched source and target roles, resets the target world, and permits only a declared agent artifact to cross the source-target boundary. For each probe, no-prior, related, unrelated, and shuffled source conditions are evaluated under matched environment-step budgets and five seeds; we report TSR, WGP, and VMP and retain provenance records. The benchmark reveals a consistent direct-capability gap between controller and planner-backed variants, while related experience yields no stable transfer: it does not improve either tool probe, its small wood-species gain hinges on one seed, and all intervals include zero. Stage audits further show that early wood-collection and crafting bottlenecks often leave later capabilities unobserved. MC-EvoBench thus offers a controlled testbed for durable, transferable embodied capabilities. Code and data are available at this https URL
2610.13829.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / South China University of Technology / Huazhong University of Science and Technology / Beihang University / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / USTC
2610.13829.update_target: Durable capability transfer across reset Minecraft worlds
2610.13829.mechanism_en: Nineteen registered chains and three paired probe families transfer only declared artifacts; no-prior, related, unrelated, and shuffled conditions use matched steps and five seeds.
2610.13829.result_en: Related experience yields no stable transfer: both tool probes fail to improve, the small wood-species gain depends on one seed, and every interval includes zero.
2610.13829.boundary_en: Stage bottlenecks can leave later skills unobserved. Saved memory, carried resources, and final success must be separated from learned transferable capability.
2610.13829.abstract_zh: 具身递归自改进的核心挑战，是把交互历史转化为超出单一世界、可迁移到后续任务的持久能力。保存记忆或最终动作成功，不足以证明获得可复用能力；评估必须把能力变化与携带资源、不同源经验暴露和早期执行失败区分。我们构建 MC-EvoBench，一个受控 Minecraft 基准，固定登记 19 条演化链，包括 12 条主要评估链和 7 条校准或探查链，并有三组与任务图对齐的配对迁移探查。每个任务表示为任务状态图，设定阶段环境验证器、匹配源和目标角色，重置目标世界，并只允许声明的智能体产物跨越源—目标边界。每个探查在匹配环境步预算和五个种子下，比较无先验、相关、不相关和打乱的源条件，报告 TSR、WGP、VMP 并保留来源记录。基准显示控制器与规划器变体之间持续存在直接能力差距，而相关经验没有稳定迁移：两个工具探查均不改善，木材种类上的小收益依赖单一种子，全部区间都包含零。阶段审计还发现，早期木材收集和制作瓶颈常使后续能力无法被观察。因此，MC-EvoBench 为持久、可迁移具身能力提供受控测试环境。代码和数据可通过原摘要所附链接获取。

2610.13881.title: Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State
2610.13881.abstract_en: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention. For smooth convex residual losses with unrestricted real features and labels, a continuous recurrent state of fixed dimension exists exactly when the loss is polynomial. With ordinary, unweighted observations, degree $D$ requires precisely $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ coordinates; even among histories with one fixed current predictor, exactly $r-d$ coordinates can remain necessary for continuation. Nonpolynomial losses have unbounded requirements on such equal-prediction histories. Bounded scalar logistic examples retain this obstruction after fixing any finite derivative jet. For ridge regression, the hidden evidence is the design matrix: the exact state costs $dp+d(d+1)/2$, versus $dp$ for the predictor. On a well-conditioned zero-prediction family, optimal $B$-bit compression has average one-update error of order $d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$, $s_d=d(d+1)/2$, even with arbitrary randomized codes. Kernel attention gives a second exact closure classification. The results identify what future updates reveal, rather than proposing a new regression algorithm or asserting trained-model gains.
2610.13881.update_target: Exact memory-state requirements for future cumulative updates
2610.13881.mechanism_en: Theory compares histories with identical predictions but different update-relevant evidence, classifying polynomial losses and kernel-attention closure under explicit assumptions.
2610.13881.result_en: Degree-D residual losses require binom(d+D,D)−1 coordinates; ridge state needs dp+d(d+1)/2, beyond dp predictor coordinates.
2610.13881.boundary_en: These are exact-state and compression bounds under stated feature, continuity, and loss assumptions; the paper makes no trained-model performance claim.
2610.13881.abstract_zh: 能够复现所有当前预测的记忆，仍可能忘记如何从下一次观察学习。我们对精确累积学习和注意力刻画这一差别。对于光滑凸残差损失，若实值特征和标签不受限制，固定维度连续循环状态存在，当且仅当损失为多项式。对普通未加权观测，D 次损失恰需 r = binom(d+D, D) − 1 个坐标；即使历史具有相同当前预测器，继续学习仍可能恰需 r−d 个坐标。非多项式损失在这些等预测历史上具有无界需求。即使固定任意有限阶导数信息，有界标量逻辑回归例子仍保留此障碍。对岭回归，隐藏证据是设计矩阵：精确状态成本为 dp+d(d+1)/2，而预测器仅需 dp。在良态零预测族上，即使允许任意随机编码，最优 B 位压缩的平均单次更新误差仍为 d⁻¹·2^(−2B/s_d) 的量级，其中 s_d=d(d+1)/2。核注意力提供第二种精确闭包分类。这些结果识别未来更新会揭示哪些信息，并非提出新回归算法或声称训练模型性能提升。

2610.13287.title: Do Prompt Optimizers Break Requirements They Are Not Scored On? A Preregistered Study
2610.13287.abstract_en: Prompt optimizers rewrite a prompt to raise one target metric, but prompts also state requirements the metric does not score, such as an output format, citations, or abstention. In a preregistered study, we run GEPA, MIPROv2, and TextGrad on HotpotQA, SQuAD 2.0, and IFEval and count per-item violations of unscored requirements with deterministic checks. By the preregistered criterion, all three optimizers produce regressions, substantially on HotpotQA, where net regression in citation validity reaches 10.7 to 41.6 points while exact match rises by 21 to 34 points. A post-hoc decomposition changes this reading. The optimized prompts elicit reasoning before the required JSON object, and under the 200-token output cap used throughout, 13.9% to 47.0% of responses end before any answer appears. Among parseable outputs, net regression is within 3 points of zero. With a 1,024-token cap, extraction failures disappear, content regression stays below 1 point, and exact match rises further. Two simple gates fail the preregistered criterion. The side effect is narrower than hypothesized: optimized prompts are more accurate and break an explicit output contract, and a lenient target metric does not show the cost.
2610.13287.update_target: Unscored output-contract regressions during prompt optimization
2610.13287.mechanism_en: A preregistered study uses deterministic requirement checks for GEPA, MIPROv2, and TextGrad; post-hoc analyses vary parseability and output-token caps.
2610.13287.result_en: Citation regression is 10.7–41.6 points with a 200-token cap; at 1,024 tokens, extraction failures vanish and content regression stays below one point.
2610.13287.boundary_en: Report the preregistered violation and the narrower post-hoc explanation together: higher accuracy can coexist with broken output contracts under a strict cap.
2610.13287.abstract_zh: 提示优化器改写提示以提高某个目标指标，但提示也包含该指标不计分的要求，例如输出格式、引用或拒答。在一项预注册研究中，我们在 HotpotQA、SQuAD 2.0 和 IFEval 上运行 GEPA、MIPROv2 与 TextGrad，用确定性检查统计逐样本违反未计分要求的情况。按预注册标准，三种优化器都产生退化，HotpotQA 尤其明显：引用有效性的净退化达到 10.7–41.6 点，而精确匹配提高 21–34 点。事后分解改变了这一解读。优化提示让模型在所需 JSON 对象前输出推理；全程使用的 200 token 输出上限使 13.9%–47.0% 响应在答案出现前结束。在可解析输出中，净退化距零在 3 点以内。将上限提高到 1,024 token 后，提取失败消失，内容退化低于 1 点，精确匹配进一步提高。两种简单门控未通过预注册标准。副作用比原假设更窄：优化提示更准确，却破坏明确输出契约，宽松目标指标没有反映这一成本。

2610.12707.title: Unsupervised Multimodal Reward Modeling
2610.12707.authors: Yueying Li, Jingxuan Fan, Kianté Brantley, Sham M. Kakade, Hanlin Zhang
2610.12707.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.12707.abstract_en: Vision-language reward models are trained on annotated preference pairs, which are expensive to collect, can disagree, and are ranked by benchmark accuracy. We build one with no human preference label: a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone, trained to score a web caption above a perturbed version of the same caption; labeled data enters only to select the layer. The layer is the decisive choice, worth 5.8 points over the last layer, and one recipe transferred without re-tuning beats or at least matches GPT-4o on three benchmarks at 32B, 6.6 points ahead on VL-RewardBench, from a few thousand parameters at about a thousandth of fine-tuning compute. At an equal pair budget, perturbations teach a frozen head 3 to 5 points more than curated RLAIF-V pairs. Because the backbone is frozen, the objective is convex, and the perturbation sampler specifies the reward, which the benchmark does not identify: two heads trained on disjoint halves of the same perturbations tie on the benchmark and differ by 6.4 points in hallucination judging. Retraining the head on the policy's own verifier-labeled candidates cuts caption hallucination by 5.1 CHAIR points and lifts image-generation pass rate by 5.4, while scoring lower on every reward benchmark. Together, an intermediate-layer probe, free same-image perturbations, and a verifier-driven bootstrap turn give a recipe for multimodal reward modeling that needs no annotator, costs a fraction of fine-tuning, and is specified by the comparisons it is trained on rather than by a benchmark rank.
2610.12707.affiliation: MIT / Cornell University / Scale AI / Harvard University
2610.12707.update_target: A lightweight reward head over a frozen VLM
2610.12707.mechanism_en: Same-image perturbations train a convex intermediate-layer head; policy-generated, verifier-labeled candidates support a subsequent bootstrap retraining turn.
2610.12707.result_en: Verifier-minted pairs reduce caption hallucination by 5.1 CHAIR points and raise image-generation pass rate by 5.4, while reward-benchmark scores worsen.
2610.12707.boundary_en: Included for verifier-driven reward adaptation and the benchmark–policy mismatch. One bootstrap turn does not prove indefinitely reliable co-evolution.
2610.12707.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言奖励模型通常在昂贵、可能意见不一致的标注偏好对上训练，并按基准准确率排名。我们无需人类偏好标签构建奖励模型：在冻结 Qwen3-VL 的中间层加入线性头，训练其把网页图像描述排在同一描述的扰动版本之上；带标签数据只用于选择层。层选择是决定因素，比最后一层高 5.8 点。一个无需重新调优的配方在 32B 规模的三个基准上优于或至少匹配 GPT-4o，在 VL-RewardBench 上领先 6.6 点，仅用数千参数，计算量约为微调的千分之一。在相同配对预算下，扰动数据比精选 RLAIF-V 对使冻结主干上的头高 3–5 点。主干冻结使目标凸，而扰动采样器定义奖励，基准不能识别该奖励：在相同扰动的两个不相交子集上训练的头，在基准上持平，却在幻觉判断上相差 6.4 点。用策略自身、由验证器标记的候选重新训练头，使描述幻觉降低 5.1 个 CHAIR 点、图像生成通过率提高 5.4 点，尽管所有奖励基准分数更低。中间层探针、无需标注的同图扰动与验证器驱动的自举回合，共同构成无需标注者、成本远低于微调的多模态奖励建模配方；其定义来自训练比较，而非基准排名。
