2610.13166.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
2610.13166.authors: Shun Zou, Ziyu Ma, Yi Zou, Yong Wang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Guanhua Chen, Xiangxiang Chu, Feng Zhao
2610.13166.abstract_en: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional work, it uses independent execution to identify key work omitted during construction and uses the resulting evidence to guide environment reconstruction. To extend these patterns across stages, it progressively expands tasks under the same goal, introducing new requirements that build on prior results and call for further exploration and improvement. Using this engine, we construct 1.5K task environments and perform supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting dataset to obtain TerminalHorizon-27B. We achieve substantial performance gains on all 12 benchmarks spanning coding-agent tasks, agentic tasks in real-world production settings, and general reasoning. Multiple RSI case studies, each with a 12-hour research budget, further demonstrate the model's ability to continue experimenting beyond an initial solution, improve its methods based on feedback, and retain effective improvements in its final deliverables.
2610.13166.affiliation: USTC / AMAP, Alibaba Group / Southern University of Science and Technology
2610.13166.update_target: Synthesized task environments and a terminal model trained on retained trajectories
2610.13166.mechanism_en: Independent execution identifies missing work and guides environment reconstruction; same-goal task expansion carries prior results into later stages and research feedback guides retained method improvements.
2610.13166.result_en: 1.5K environments train TerminalHorizon-27B; all 12 benchmarks improve, with additional RSI case studies using 12-hour research budgets.
2610.13166.boundary_en: Separate environment-synthesis feedback, one-time SFT, and task-level RSI case studies. The abstract gives no numerical benchmark headline.
2610.13166.abstract_zh: 终端智能体正从局部操作转向完成现实专业任务。短轨迹能演示命令和工具调用，却不能完整展示智能体如何通过探索积累证据、用证据形成判断、依据反馈持续调整策略，并把中间结果变成最终交付。高质量长周期轨迹在一个求解过程中连接这些行为模式，为持续自主工作提供更丰富经验。但环境合成可能提前完成或简化这些行为背后的关键工作，去掉智能体本应执行的探索、实现和验证。为此，我们提出 TerminalHorizon，一个面向长周期终端智能体的全自动数据合成引擎。从真实专业工作出发，通过独立执行识别构造时遗漏的关键工作，并用证据指导环境重建。为跨阶段扩展行为模式，在同一目标下逐步扩展任务，引入依赖此前结果、需要进一步探索和改善的新要求。我们构建 1.5K 个任务环境，并在所得数据上监督微调 Qwen3.5-27B，获得 TerminalHorizon-27B。它在涵盖代码智能体、真实生产智能体和通用推理的全部 12 个基准上取得显著收益。多个 RSI 案例研究分别采用 12 小时研究预算，进一步展示模型能在初始解之后继续实验，依据反馈改进方法，并在最终交付中保留有效改进。
2610.13166.image_caption: Figure 1: Motivation for TerminalHorizon. Short trajectories can teach agents to perform terminal operations, but not to autonomously complete complex, long-horizon tasks. Our long-horizon trajectories connect agentic behavioral patterns, such as exploration, strategy revision, and verification, into a complete autonomous problem-solving process.

2610.13272.title: OWLET: On-Policy Weighted Learning via Evidence Transfer for Video Large Language Model Post-Training
2610.13272.authors: Qitan Lv, Ke Fan, Hong Wang, Wen Wu, Yilin Wang, Bowen Zhou, Feng Wu, Chao Zhang
2610.13272.abstract_en: Post-training has become a key stage for eliciting reasoning capabilities in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs). Existing post-training methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, they do not fully exploit visual evidence for effective training. RL supervises the policy with a single trajectory-level reward, which is too coarse-grained for video reasoning: the same response-level advantage is applied to every generated token, disregarding that the tokens of a video response are grounded in the visual stream to very different degrees. OPD provides token-level supervision through output-distribution matching, but lacks direct supervision of the spatiotemporal representations that produce those outputs. We observe across extensive experiments that the same model reasons more accurately when its video view combines global temporal context with question-relevant details. Comparing the same student-generated response under this view and uniform sampling reveals changes in token likelihoods and internal representations, providing a training signal for evidence use. Building on this observation, we propose OWLET, an evidence-privileged RL method that derives training signals from a richer teacher view. This view couples uniform global context with question-conditioned local windows, providing visual evidence without requiring a larger model. To better exploit this privileged visual evidence, OWLET introduces (i) \textbf{evidence-aware credit redistribution}, which compares token likelihoods across the two views and redistributes positive response-level advantages according to their relative evidence support; and (ii) \textbf{spatiotemporal state alignment}, which aligns the two views' hidden states on verifier-accepted responses.
2610.13272.affiliation: USTC / Shanghai AI Laboratory / Tsinghua University
2610.13272.update_target: Video-policy token credit and spatiotemporal representations
2610.13272.mechanism_en: The same student response is compared under uniform and evidence-rich views; relative token likelihood redistributes positive advantage and verifier-accepted responses receive hidden-state alignment.
2610.13272.result_en: The abstract reports more accurate reasoning with global-plus-question-local evidence, then specifies the two training mechanisms without a quantitative benchmark result.
2610.13272.boundary_en: This is an evidence-privileged self-supervision mechanism, not an autonomous repeated agent-evolution result. Do not invent missing performance numbers.
2610.13272.abstract_zh: 后训练已成为激发视频大语言模型推理能力的关键阶段。现有方法主要采用强化学习和在策略蒸馏，却没有充分利用视觉证据。RL 用单个轨迹级奖励监督策略，对视频推理过于粗糙：所有生成 token 使用相同响应级优势，忽略了它们扎根于视觉流的程度不同。在策略蒸馏通过输出分布匹配提供 token 级监督，却不直接监督产生输出的时空表示。我们在广泛实验中观察到，同一模型的视频视图兼具全局时间上下文与问题相关细节时，推理更准确。对同一学生生成响应，比较丰富视图与均匀采样下的 token 似然和内部表示变化，可获得证据使用的训练信号。我们提出 OWLET，一种从更丰富教师视图获得训练信号的证据特权 RL 方法。该视图结合均匀全局上下文和问题条件局部窗口，无需更大模型。为更好利用特权视觉证据，OWLET 引入两项机制：证据感知信用再分配，比较两种视图下的 token 似然，按相对证据支持重分配正响应级优势；时空状态对齐，在验证器接受的响应上对齐两种视图的隐藏状态。
2610.13272.image_caption: Figure 1: Illustration of how OWLET improves video reasoning through evidence-guided post-training. Uniform frame sampling misses the temporal transitions needed to answer the question, whereas OWLET learns from a correct evidence-privileged teacher.

2610.13886.title: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems
2610.13886.authors: Yeonsung Jung, Zhiyuan Wang, Zifan Wang, Vítor Albiero, Benjamin Newman, Edoardo Debenedetti, Ivan Evtimov, Ninareh Mehrabi
2610.13886.abstract_en: Personal agents increasingly connect to services across the web and applications by using tools. As the effects of their actions accumulate and interact across services, unintended or harmful outcomes can arise when agents fulfill benign user requests. Proactively identifying these compositional failures requires systematically exploring diverse cross-service paths. Existing red-teaming methods often simply prompt LLMs to identify potentially harmful paths from task and environment descriptions or decompose harmful objectives specified by humans or LLMs into seemingly benign action combinations. However, generation is biased toward patterns learned during training, potentially favoring familiar tool combinations and leaving novel cross-service interactions underexplored. To address this, we propose X-AgentRed, a self-evolving red-teaming framework that discovers harmful tool call paths through a graph of tool dependencies and expands and refines them using execution feedback. By analyzing each tool's effects, potential harms, and preconditions for execution, the red-teaming agent constructs a directed graph that captures how one tool's effects can satisfy another's execution preconditions. Recipes sampled from this graph are instantiated as realistic scenarios in which agents can produce harmful outcomes. Execution feedback enables self-improvement by diversifying paths that produce harm through tool substitution and refining preconditions at blocked steps in unsuccessful paths to enable further execution. Across four frontier agentic models, X-AgentRed achieves $1.77\times$ the harmful path rate of STAC and explores a more diverse set of tools, yielding $2.99\times$ the tool coverage on average.
2610.13886.affiliation: Meta Reality Labs Research / Meta Superintelligence Labs / Meta / FAIR at Meta
2610.13886.update_target: Tool-dependency graph recipes and adversarial path preconditions
2610.13886.mechanism_en: Execution feedback diversifies successful harmful paths through tool substitution and revises blocked preconditions in unsuccessful paths for further exploration.
2610.13886.result_en: Across four frontier agentic models, harmful-path rate is 1.77x STAC and mean tool coverage is 2.99x.
2610.13886.boundary_en: This evolves a red-teaming search mechanism, not the target agent’s weights. Generated coverage and observed harm require separate measurement.
2610.13886.abstract_zh: 个人智能体通过工具连接网页和应用的不同服务。动作效果累积并跨服务相互作用时，即使完成良性请求也可能产生意外或有害结果。主动识别组合失败需要系统探索多样跨服务路径。现有红队方法往往直接提示 LLM 从任务和环境描述中识别有害路径，或把人类或 LLM 指定的有害目标分解为看似良性的动作组合。但生成偏向训练中学到的模式，可能偏爱熟悉工具组合，遗漏新跨服务交互。我们提出 X-AgentRed，一个自进化红队框架，通过工具依赖图发现有害调用路径，并用执行反馈扩展和细化路径。红队智能体分析工具效果、潜在危害和执行前置条件，构建有向图，表示一个工具的效果如何满足另一工具的前置条件。从图采样的配方被实例化为可能导致有害结果的现实场景。执行反馈通过两种方式支持自改进：对产生危害的路径替换工具以增加多样性，对失败路径中的阻塞步骤细化前置条件以支持继续执行。对四个前沿智能体模型，X-AgentRed 的有害路径率为 STAC 的 1.77 倍，探索工具更多，平均工具覆盖率为其 2.99 倍。
